stories.title: 'I cannot forget the pain of a lifetime':One year after Pahalgam attack, victim Shubham Dwivedi's wife Aishanya says, 'No justice till terrorism is eradicated'
stories.summary: The Pahalgam terrorist attack occurred exactly one year ago today on April 22. Terrorists killed 26 people after asking their names and religion. 30-year-old Shubham Dwivedi from Kanpur was shot in the head in front of his wife Aishanya. Shubham and Aishanya had been married for just two months. Even one year after the terrorist attack, tears come to Aishanya's eyes when she remembers Shubham. She says she could neither celebrate their anniversary nor any festival. Shubham's father Sanjay Dwivedi has kept his son's photograph in his office, which he looks at before sitting on his chair. He also organizes a community feast in his village every month in Shubham's name. Aishanya and Shubham's father Sanjay Dwivedi had an exclusive conversation with Bhaskar. They shared their emotions. Aishanya said, ‘There can be no greater sorrow than when a son leaves the world in front of his parents. When someone who had been married for just two months has their husband killed by terrorists right in front of them, no one can forget that. Now this has become a lifelong pain.’ 'How happy we were, everything was destroyed' Aishanya becomes emotional remembering the entire incident. She says, ‘We had gone out for a trip on April 17 last year. Since that date this year, I have been constantly remembering those moments. I am looking at the pictures from that time. Looking at those pictures, it feels like how happy we were, but April 22 destroyed everything for me.’ 'The pain of a lifetime...I cannot forget' Aishanya says, 'When a 30-year-old son passes away in front of his parents, there can be no greater sorrow than that. When a life partner is snatched away in front of their spouse, when their husband is killed, no one can forget that. This is a lifelong trauma. There were 26 people with her husband, her husband was killed in front of the wives. This is the pain of an entire lifetime. I cannot forget this.' 'I don't understand whom to tell about the good work' Aishanya says, 'When you lose someone, every day becomes difficult. Whether it's a festival or an anniversary. We had been married for only two months. I didn't celebrate any anniversary with him, nor any festival. I remember him every moment. Whenever I do something good, I feel like sharing it, then I wonder who should I tell.' 'I am getting strength from my family itself' Aishanya says that, ‘If family is with you, that is the biggest strength. Along with my in-laws, I also got the support of my parents. Because of which we were able to bear all this. We became strong because of staying together. I am getting strength from my family itself.’ 'No second meeting with PM, CM had come' Aishanya says, 'There was no second meeting with PM Modi but the CM had come to our place. Then my father-in-law, Shubham's father, met the CM in June-July 2025. There were also conversations over the phone several times. There are attempts to meet the CM, but due to the Bengal elections, the meeting could not happen yet. But I have to meet him, I am trying.' 'Relief will come only when terrorism is completely eliminated' Aishanya says, ‘After Operation Sindoor, Operation Mahadev also took place, in which terrorist hideouts were first destroyed. In Operation Mahadev, those terrorists who had done this were eliminated. Information keeps coming that military operations continue to be conducted at other hideouts in Kashmir as well. Both operations are a relief, but until terrorism is completely eliminated, full relief will not be achieved.’ 'Is your country first or religion?' Aishanya says, 'This is not just a terrorist attack, but a Hindu genocide. Because there, Hindus were targeted based on their religion, forced to recite the Kalma, and then killed. They were asked whether they were Hindu or Muslim. If Muslim, recite the Kalma, then they were targeted. Terrorism has no religion. Terrorists have a very disgusting mindset, they are not human. In our Puranas, there were demons, these are those same demons. Why are they only from one particular religious community, I don't have an answer to that. But this question must certainly be asked: is your country first or your religion?' 'Making efforts to preserve memories' Aishanya says that Assembly Speaker Satish Mahana has been in constant touch with our family. He also had a gate built in Shubham's ancestral village. When he came to lay its foundation stone, he said that they would also install a biopic of Shubham in the digital library of the Assembly. Every effort is being made to preserve Shubham's memories. We met him just two days ago. We keep talking on the phone as well. He is the one person who is constantly in touch with us. The tender for a park has been done, some technical matters are stuck. As soon as they are completed, work on the park will begin. There is no information about other things yet. Aishanya's response on the question of entering politics When asked about entering politics, Aishanya says, 'I am 28 years old right now, I have never thought about anything like that. But if the question is there, then I have always been involved in social work anyway. Now I don't have a life partner in my life, so I keep thinking about doing social work only.' 'What will happen ahead, I don't know, because whatever has happened in my life till now, I had never thought about that either. Two months after marriage, I lost everything in the attack, I had never thought about that either.' Father Sanjay says, ‘Never thought even in dreams that such an incident would happen’ We also spoke to Shubham's father Sanjay Dwivedi. Recalling those moments, he says, 'It had been only two months since his son's wedding. Both families had happily planned together for the children to go to Kashmir.' 'But never thought even in dreams that such an incident would happen with the family. After that, what happened, there can be no greater sorrow than this for us and the family. Every day we remember him, but as God keeps you, you have to remain that way.' 'As that date is approaching, the memory of that accident and that day is becoming fresh. On April 22, a program is also being organized in Kanpur to pay tribute to Shubham. The courage, cooperation and strength that the people of Kanpur have given us has helped us bear that grief.' It was difficult to console Shubham's mother after the accident Sanjay Dwivedi says that on February 26, Shubham's birthday, and on February 12, the day he got married, he was missed very much. 'The biggest difficulty was in consoling Shubham's mother. We cannot take anyone away from Shubham's memory, but still somehow we managed to console them.' Sanjay says, 'On the 22nd of every month, we organize a feast in our village in Shubham's name, so on that date it feels like how many months have passed since Shubham left us.' Operation Sindoor gave us satisfaction Sanjay Dwivedi says that ‘Assembly Speaker Satish Mahana is very close to our family. When I was coming from Kashmir with Shubham, the CM also called me. The government helped us a lot.’ 'The government conducted Operation Sindoor, which not only gave us satisfaction but also must have brought peace to Shubham's soul. I had made a demand to the PM that it was an attack on the country, in which 26 people were killed by terrorists. Therefore, we had demanded that martyr status be given. We are still making that demand.' 'During that time, leaders of several political parties had met and also put forward my demand. Even Rahul Gandhi had said that he would write a letter to the PM for this. As for Akhilesh Yadav, he did not come to meet, because he had said that we come from the upper caste, so he won't come. He only goes to Muslims and PDA people's places. He has no concern for us.' Terrorists shot tourists in the valley after asking their names Shubham Dwivedi (30) from Kanpur was shot dead in a terrorist attack in Pahalgam, Jammu and Kashmir on April 22, 2025. Aishanya had told that she was sitting with Shubham at a restaurant in Baisaran valley. Around 2:15 PM, terrorists came and started firing indiscriminately. This created a chaotic situation there. A terrorist asked Shubham his name. As soon as he revealed his name, Shubham was shot in the head. Shubham fell to the ground and Aishanya fainted. 26 people were killed in the terrorist attack. After this, the Indian government launched Operation Sindoor against Pakistan.

stories.title: Temperatures rise to 44°C in UP:Heatwave alert in 35 districts, Prayagraj hottest; rain likely after 4 days of intense heat
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh is experiencing intense heat. A heat wave alert has been issued for 35 districts today, Wednesday. The sun has shone brightly since morning, and strong winds are blowing. The Indian Meteorological Department (IMD) says there is no hope of relief from the heat for four days, until April 25th. The mercury could reach 45°C. However, rain is expected on April 26th. In the last 24 hours, temperatures in 30 districts across the state have exceeded 40°C. Prayagraj was the hottest, reaching 44.4°C during the day. Two hippos were seen frolicking underwater at the Gorakhpur Zoo. A tourist visiting the Taj Mahal in Agra fell unconscious. Five to six tourists fell ill. The intense heat has led to numerous fires across the state. A market in Ghaziabad caught fire amid the scorching sun, destroying 20 shops, including a restaurant. Buses also caught fire in Meerut and Lucknow. In Meerut, the bus was carrying about 50 passengers. However, everyone was able to safely evacuate before the fire spread. In view of the increasing heat and heatwave, the Basic Education Department has changed the opening hours of council schools. Now, all council schools in the state will open from 7:30 am to 1:30 pm. Classes will run from 7:30 am to 12:30 pm. After this, teachers and other staff will remain in the school until 1:30 pm to complete academic and administrative work. Visuals of the intense heat Heat wave warning in these 30 districts The 30 districts for which the Meteorological Department has issued a heat wave warning include Pilibhit, Shahjahanpur, Lakhimpur Kheri, Sitapur, Bahraich, Shravasti, Balrampur, Gonda, Basti, Sant Kabir Nagar, Siddharthnagar, Maharajganj, Gorakhpur, Kushinagar, Deoria, Azamgarh, Mau, Ballia, Ghazipur, Jaunpur, Varanasi, Chandauli, Mirzapur, Sonbhadra, Prayagraj, Pratapgarh, Amethi, Ambedkar Nagar, Sultanpur, Ayodhya and surrounding areas. Meteorologists say that now the night temperature will also rise. Gradually the minimum temperature will reach 25 to 30°C. Avoid going out of the house during the afternoon. The Meteorological Department has urged people to be cautious about the heat. They have advised people to avoid prolonged exposure to the sun and to only venture outside during the day when absolutely necessary. They have also urged people to take special care of children and the elderly. The Meteorological Department has advised people to drink plenty of water. Wear light and loose clothing. Cover your head when leaving the house. Use a hat, scarf, or umbrella. Contact a doctor if you experience dizziness, headache, high fever, vomiting, or weakness. How will the weather be in the next 5 days? April 23 – Bright sunshine will prevail across the state. Humidity will increase due to reduced wind speed. April 24 – Eastern and western Uttar Pradesh will experience intense sunshine, with heat waves possible in some areas during the afternoon. April 25 – The weather will be dry with bright sunshine throughout the state. A heat wave will develop during the afternoon. April 26 – A heat wave alert has been issued for eastern and western Uttar Pradesh. The intense sun will increase humidity. April 27 – Rain and thundershowers are possible in western Uttar Pradesh, while eastern Uttar Pradesh will remain hot.

stories.title: 'Muslims who become saints are welcomed, so why oppose me?':Influencer turned Sadhvi Harsha Richhariya says, 'I will remain active on social media'
stories.summary: 'I am not Sita, that I should give an Agni Pariksha (trial by fire). The story that began with Mahakumbh 2025 is now ending. I faced opposition, character assassination and mental pressure. Therefore, now leaving the path of religion, I am returning to my old profession.' Social media influencer Harsha Richhariya said these things in a video on January 12, 2026. Just 3 months after this statement, on April 19, 2026, she took Sannyasa (renunciation) in Ujjain. She performed her own Pindadan and Shraddh. After this, she received a new name, Sadhvi Harshanand Giri. Bhaskar spoke with Harsha about the reason for taking Sannyasa and about her future plans. Read the full report. Harsha said, 'An inner voice came to take Sannyasa' Harsha was in Ujjain. We spoke to her on mobile. The first question asked was what was the reason behind taking Sannyasa? Harsha says, 'I had reached Mahakumbh for the first time as a Sadhvi. From what I felt there, the thought came that now Sannyasa can be taken.' 'From that very time my mind was wandering. After Mahakumbh, I became connected to Dharma. I understood everything related to Sanatan properly. In December 2025, my mind was firmly made up that now I should take Sannyasa. I listened to my inner voice and now have taken Sannyasa. No guru inspired me to do this.' 'Mother's condition deteriorated upon hearing about renunciation' We asked - What did your parents say when they heard about renunciation? She says, 'They were shocked. Why wouldn't they be. Every family would find it strange if their daughter talks about taking renunciation. They didn't agree. My mother was crying continuously. Her condition had worsened significantly. But, gradually they understood that I wasn't going to do anything wrong. Now mother is not with me, nor am I with her. Now I don't know what condition she is in. Perhaps she must have understood that ultimately renunciation is the truth.' Harsha says, 'Not teaching anything wrong on social media' We asked, 'Despite taking Sannyasa, will you continue giving spiritual messages on social media? She says- Tell me one thing, am I teaching anything wrong on social media...no, right? In today's date, big leaders and religious gurus are active on social media. Lakhs of people listen to and watch their messages. I don't think there's a need to distance myself from it. Through this, we can reach our message far and wide.' 'The reason for my troubles was none other than saints' We asked - Why did you say that on the path of dharma you only found character assassination? Harsha says, ‘I had never come so close to Sanatan Dharma before Mahakumbh. When I came, many sadhus and saints started opposing me.’ 'They started saying that a dancer-singer has been made a sanyasi, whereas where was I dancing and singing. I used to do anchoring. I had built my identity through that work. I never did anything wrong. Despite this, I was opposed.' 'There was a time when I became very troubled. The reason for my trouble was none other than the saints themselves. At that time, it came to my mind that when a Muslim person adopts Hinduism, people welcome them so much. But when a daughter of Hindu dharma came, even religious gurus started opposing. Seeing all this, my mind was disturbed.' 'The path of religion is not easy for girls' Do you think the path of religion is difficult for girls? Harsha says, 'Women are emotional. People take advantage of this. That's why the path of religion is a bit difficult for women. When a woman is not wrong, she breaks down quickly.' 'She starts thinking what sin have I committed that I am being targeted. To break a woman, people start character assassination. Because, they know that no matter how strong a girl is, when it comes to character, she will break.' 'Some saints also raised fingers at my character. They said many things, but I stood firm. What they were saying was their mentality. What I am doing is my decision.' On posting bridal look photos, she says, ‘Now everything is left behind’ We asked - You had shared your pictures in western clothes 4 days ago. Was that to remember for the last time? She says, 'There was a lot of pressure on me. I didn't want to tell anyone what I was going to do next. That's why 4 days ago I confused people by posting bridal look videos-photos. Those pictures were old. Just posted them that day. Now I have taken sannyasa. Everything is left behind.' 'Will work for the country and society' What are your future plans? Harsha says, 'What can I tell you now. I'll just say this much that now I will work openly for society, for the younger generation and for the country. This is not wrong work. Now if someone has a problem even with the right thing, then I can't do anything about it.'

stories.title: 'Blue drum' murder accused Muskaan claims she is being framed:Says, 'I was touring Shimla-Mussoorie with Sahil'; questioned in Meerut court
stories.summary: In the Saurabh Rajput murder case of Meerut, the accused duo of Muskaan-Sahil presented their side in the district court on Tuesday, 21 April. Judge Anupam Kumar asked both of them 32 questions. Both said, 'We are being falsely implicated in Saurabh Rajput's murder.' Muskaan-Sahil completely denied the allegations. However, they admitted to visiting and staying together in Kasol-Mussoorie and Shimla after the murder. Both said in their answers that we went on a trip together, but we did not commit murder. What happened in court? In District Judge Anupam Kumar's court, proceedings under Section-313 took place in the Saurabh Rajput murder case. Murder accused Muskaan-Sahil presented their side one by one. District Judge Anupam Kumar first asked Sahil 32 questions. After this, Muskaan was called to the witness box. Muskaan was also asked the same 32 questions. Both their statements were recorded. After this, Muskaan-Sahil were sent to the district jail. 7 major questions asked to Sahil Question: You are accused of murdering Muskaan's husband Saurabh Rajput. What do you have to say? Answer: This accusation is completely false, I am innocent. Question: Why has a case been filed against you? Answer: I don't know why this murder charge has been put on me? I am being falsely implicated. I had just gone for a stroll, that's why they are framing me. Question: Do you have anything to say in your defense or in your favor? Answer: No, nothing more to say. I'll just say that I have been wrongly implicated. Question: Hotel owners in Shimla, Kasol, Mussoorie say that you stayed in hotels here? Answer: Yes, that is correct. Question: Saurabh's friends say that they saw you going to Muskaan's house? Answer: This is completely false. I did not go to her house. Question: The drum seller, knife, cutter, sand sellers said that you purchased these items from them? Answer: All these allegations are completely false. I did not purchase any items. Question: Do you have anything to say in your defense, anything to present? Answer: Yes, I want to present my side. I want to give my defense. Sahil says, ‘I will present witnesses in court to prove my innocence’ When the judge asked Sahil in court if he wanted to say anything in his defense? To this, Sahil said in strong words, ‘I am innocent, I am being framed. I want to prove my innocence. To prove my innocence, I want to present my witness.’ The next date in the case is set for 28 April. Then Sahil's lawyer Rekha Jain will present witnesses and evidence on his behalf. ‘I was in Delhi on the night of the murder’ Sahil presented his side saying that on the night of Saurabh's murder, he was not in Meerut but in Delhi. It is believed that on April 28, Sahil will strongly present this point to prove his innocence that on the night of Saurabh's murder, he was in Delhi. Muskaan said, 'Case filed due to property dispute' When Muskaan was asked why a case was filed against you for your husband Saurabh Rajput's murder? How are you an accused? On this, Muskaan clearly said that the case was filed due to a property dispute. 7 major questions asked to Muskaan Question: You are accused of murdering your husband Saurabh Rajput, what do you say? Answer: This accusation is completely false, I am innocent. Question: Why was a case filed against you? Answer: I have been wrongly implicated in the case due to a property dispute. Question: Do you want to say anything in your defense or on your behalf? Answer: No, nothing more to say. I will just say that I have been wrongly implicated. Question: Hotel owners in Shimla, Kasol, Mussoorie say that you stayed there with Sahil Shukla? Answer: Yes, that's correct. I had gone for a trip and stayed there. Question: Saurabh's friends say that they saw Sahil coming and going to your house? Answer: Wrong and false. That did not happen. Question: The drum seller, knife, cutter, sand-cement sellers said that you purchased these items from them? Answer: All these allegations are completely false. Question: A doctor residing in Brahmpuri alleges that he prescribed a medicine to you on a prescription? Answer: This is wrong and baseless. Nothing like that happened. Sahil saw Muskaan's daughter Radha for the first time Sahil-Muskaan came to court together on 21 April, 2026, after 18 March, 2025. 13 months ago, both were sent to jail after being presented in the same court. Since then, both were having online hearings. On 21 April, both remained together for about one and a half hours. First, both were kept seated in the police van, where Sahil saw the face of Muskaan's daughter Radha for the first time. After this, both were presented in court. Both remained there together for 46 minutes. However, both could not talk to each other in the courtroom. The murder case came to light on 17 March, 2025 In Meerut's Brahmpuri area, on 3 March, Saurabh was murdered by his wife Muskaan along with her lover Sahil Rajput. After this, the body was cut into 3 pieces, put in a drum, and sealed with a mixture of cement and sand. The case was uncovered on 17 March. On 18 March, Muskaan and Sahil were sent to jail. Testimony of 22 witnesses completed In the Merchant Navy Officer Saurabh murder case, statements of 22 witnesses have been recorded so far. After these testimonies, the prosecution's evidence has been closed. Now the process under Section 313 will begin in court. After this, final arguments will take place and then the court will pronounce its verdict. Know the complete case Muskaan-Sahil stayed in the lobby all night with the body Muskaan of the blue drum case reached court with daughter in her lap, arrived in police van with lover Sahil after 13 months in jail In the much-discussed Saurabh murder case of Meerut, accused Muskaan and her lover Sahil were presented in court on Tuesday. Both were brought from jail to court amid heavy security. Both remained in court for about 46 minutes. During this time, the judge questioned Sahil for 20 minutes and Muskaan for 16 minutes. After this, the police took both back to jail in the same manner they had brought them to court.

stories.title: Lover marries bride in 'mandap' meant for groom:UP man reveals five-year relationship to groom’s family hours before marriage
stories.summary: A police sub-inspector’s wedding took a dramatic and unexpected turn when it was called off just hours before the wedding procession’s departure, after the bride’s long-time lover revealed their relationship to the groom’s family. The lover later married the woman at the same wedding venue. The incident took place in the Duboulia police station area. Marriage fixed with Sub-Inspector, preparations complete The bride was set to marry John Major, a sub-inspector in the Uttar Pradesh Police, currently posted in Lucknow. His father, Dharmraj Chaudhary, is a principal at a government inter college in Uttarakhand. The wedding was scheduled for 20 April, and both families had completed all arrangements. Invitations had been distributed, guests had arrived, and pre-wedding rituals were underway at the groom’s residence. Lover arrives, discloses relationship On Monday, 20 April morning, just hours before the wedding procession was to depart, Sarvesh Singh, a property dealer from the Mehndawal area, arrived at the groom’s house around 11:30 am. He informed the groom’s family that he had been in a relationship with the bride for the past five years. He also warned them against proceeding with the wedding, saying he would disclose the relationship publicly if the marriage went ahead. Groom’s family calls off wedding After hearing him out, the groom’s father contacted the bride’s family to verify the claims. Upon confirmation, the groom’s family decided to call off the wedding and informed the bride’s side that the procession would not arrive. Lover marries bride in same venue The sudden cancellation caused panic at the bride’s home, where all arrangements had already been made. Soon after, Sarvesh Singh reached the bride’s house, spoke to her family, and convinced them to agree to the marriage. Later that night, he arrived as the groom with a Baraat and married his partner in the same wedding venue.

He had withdrawn Rs 30 lakh from his GPF. He had also sold a plot of land. First, see 2 pictures Now read the full story Anand alias Suvendra Singh Chauhan (33), residing in Subhash Nagar, was serving in the army. Suvendra was originally from Murli Purwa (Lachhiya) Kanchaunsi, Auraiya. Currently, he was living with his wife and two sons in a rented house in Subhash Nagar, Jhinjhak. Suvendra had come home on leave on April 13. Brother Rajendra Pratap said - 2 months ago, Suvendra had withdrawn Rs 30 lakh from his fund. He had also sold a plot. Driven by the greed for this money, his brother was murdered on the night of 26-27. On Tuesday, his wife Nidhi called, saying that Suvendra had not come out of his room for the past two days. Perhaps something untoward had happened. Upon this, we reached the spot. We broke open the door and went inside, where brother Suvendra was found dead. Rajendra alleges that his brother was killed by his wife Nidhi and brother-in-law together. Except for Nidhi, all the in-laws have absconded. The body was found naked, and there was blood scattered nearby. This suggests that he was attacked with a sharp weapon. Suvendra's aunt, Pushpa, stated that the husband and wife often used to fight. On Tuesday, his wife Nidhi informed her sister-in-law that Suvendra had not opened the room door for the past two days. A foul smell was also coming from inside. Upon receiving the information, the police reached the spot and sent the body for post-mortem. A medicine bottle and a liquor bottle were also found at the scene. The police said that the matter is being investigated. The exact cause of death will only be known after the post-mortem report comes out.

stories.title: Bride going to beauty parlor crushed by trailer:Wheel ran over head; wedding was to take place today
stories.summary: A 20-year-old bride-to-be was killed in a tragic road accident on her wedding day in Deoria district on Tuesday, turning a day of celebration into mourning. Rachna Paswan, a resident of Gaur Kothi village, was on her way to a beauty parlour when the incident occurred. She was travelling on a motorbike with her cousin sister Pooja (18) and cousin brother Mukesh. Around 2 pm, near Bariyarpur intersection—about 10 km from her home—a sand-laden trailer rammed into their bike from behind. Now know the complete matter... The impact threw all three onto the road. Rachna fell under the trailer and was run over, dying on the spot. Pooja and Mukesh sustained minor injuries and were rushed to hospital by police. Rachna was the only sister among two brothers. Her father, who works in Mumbai, had arranged her marriage two years ago with a man from Kushinagar. The wedding procession was due to arrive on April 28, and preparations were underway at home when the accident occurred. According to family members, the bike rider had applied sudden brakes near the intersection, following which the speeding trailer hit them with force. After the collision, the driver fled the scene, abandoning the vehicle. Police reached the spot, sent the body for postmortem and seized the trailer. A search is underway to trace the absconding driver. The incident has left the family devastated, with wedding celebrations turning into grief overnight.

stories.title: Fake IAS gang of 3 sisters arrested in Bareilly:Duped job seekers of ₹11 lakh using fake posts, forged letters, and false promises of govt jobs
stories.summary: Police have caught 3 sisters who were committing fraud by posing as fake IAS officers in Bareilly. Among them, two are real sisters, and one is their maternal uncle's daughter. All three sisters were defrauding people in the name of providing government jobs. One sister has completed her PHD and has also qualified for PCS Prelims. Meanwhile, the other two sisters have done an MA and a BSc. All three are married. The case is from the Baradari police station area. Now know the complete case Complaint was filed on April 26 Preeti Layal, a resident of Fike Enclave, filed a complaint at the Baradari police station on April 26. She said, “I met a woman who introduced herself as Shikha Pathak. She told me that her sister, Dr. Vipra Sharma, is an ADM (FR) and arranges government jobs in exchange for money. She claimed she could get a computer operator job through UPSSSC.” “After this, I informed my acquaintances Adil Khan, Santosh Kumar, and Mushahid. All four of us needed jobs, so we went to meet Shikha Pathak and Vipra Sharma at their house. Their father, Virendra Kumar Sharma, was also present there. On the pretext of arranging jobs, they collectively took around ₹11 lakh from the four of us through cash and bank transfers.” Two real sisters and one cousin were committing fraud Shikha Sharma (40) and Vipra Sharma (35), residents of the Baradari police station area, are real sisters. Diksha Pathak (32) is their maternal uncle's daughter. All three are married. Shikha Sharma has even been divorced. Vipra and Diksha live with their husbands. Vipra Sharma has completed a double MA, PhD, and has qualified for PCS Pre. Meanwhile, Shikha Sharma has done an MA, and Diksha Pathak has studied up to BSc. Both of them had been committing fraud along with Vipra Sharma since the year 2022. The three sisters had divided their work among themselves. Diksha would find victims, and Shikha would create the atmosphere. Meanwhile, Vipra would pose as a fake officer and make the 'final deal'. The accused sisters say that they liked using blue lights and expensive hobbies. That's why they were fulfilling their hobbies by committing fraud. After being caught, the three sisters say that they are educated. They haven't had any job till now. They have a hobby of traveling in cars with blue lights and buying expensive things. That's why they were living by posing as fake officers. With the money from the fraud, they had bought a house. Sitting there, they would make fake joining letters. Apart from this, they also bought a white colored Mahindra XUV700 car. Complaint was registered on 26 April Preeti Layal, a resident of Faik Enclave, lodged a complaint at the Baradari police station on 26 April. She stated that I met a woman. She told me her name was Shikha Pathak. Shikha Pathak told me that her sister, Dr. Vipra Sharma, is ADM FR. She takes money and gets government jobs. She claimed to get a computer operator job through UPSSSC. I informed my acquaintances Adil Khan, Santosh Kumar, and Mushahid about this. All four needed jobs. So we went to meet Shikha Pathak and Vipra Sharma at their house. Their father, Virendra Kumar Sharma, was also present there. In the name of getting jobs, they took approximately ₹11 lakh in cash and through the bank from all four people. Fraud exposed upon reaching Lucknow After this, Vipra Sharma prepared fake joining letters in the name of the Commissioner and Secretary, Revenue Council UP, Lucknow. She sent them through email, post, and WhatsApp. These letters were prepared in the name of the Revenue Council, Lucknow. These also had forged signatures of alleged officials. When the victims reached Lucknow to join, the officials there made it clear that all these letters were fake. After this, the victims realized they had been cheated. When the victims demanded their money back, the three sisters threatened them. After this, the victims filed a complaint at the Baradari police station. The police have registered a case under sections of fraud and creating fake documents and arrested the accused. Currently, the police are also investigating how many more people this gang has made victims of fraud.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:Modi arrives in Kashi to inaugurate Signature Bridge; UP’s Banda becomes the world’s hottest place at 47.6°C more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. Modi arrives in Kashi to inaugurate Signature Bridge Prime Minister Narendra Modi has reached Kashi for the women’s public protest rally. He arrived in an open jeep and waved to the crowd while making his way to the stage. UP Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, BJP president Nitin Naveen and state president Pankaj Chaudhary were also present with him in the jeep. 2. UP’s Banda becomes the world’s hottest place at 47.6°C Severe heatwave conditions swept across large parts of India on Monday. Banda in Uttar Pradesh emerged as the hottest city in the world, recording a scorching 47.6°C, surpassing its previous records. 3. Yogi announces 1 lakh new police jobs: Openings for home guards CM Yogi announced on Tuesday in Lucknow that 1 lakh new recruitments will be made in UP Police this year. He said - recruitment will be done for Home Guard, Police, and Sub-Inspector posts. The CM distributed joining letters to 936 radio operators. He also took photos with them. 4. Israel destroys over 1,000 sites in Lebanon despite ceasefire extension The Israeli military on Tuesday said it has destroyed more than 1,000 sites used by Hezbollah in southern Lebanon, including booby-trapped structures and buildings allegedly used to store weapons. 5. Mahua Moitra shares UP’s IPS Ajay Pal’s video, claims he danced with dancer Uttar Pradesh encounter specialist IPS Ajay Pal Sharma has been appointed as an observer in West Bengal by the Election Commission. Soon after taking charge, he came into action. 6. Hardoi school principal apologises for misbehaving with student’s parent In Hardoi, the principal who misbehaved with a child's parent finally had to apologise publicly. The matter escalated when workers of the Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad reached the school premises for a protest. 7. Campaigning ends for Phase 2 of WB polls Campaigning for the second phase of the West Bengal Assembly elections concluded on Monday evening, setting the stage for polling across 142 seats on April 29. 8. Ganga Expressway passing through 12 districts to open tomorrow The Ganga Expressway in UP is ready. PM Modi will inaugurate it on April 29. This 594-kilometre expressway will connect Meerut to Prayagraj. It will change the face of the 12 districts it passes through. 9. BJP plans to deploy women ministers; Akhilesh to promote Ragini Sonkar and Naseem Solanki After the Women's Reservation Amendment Bill failed in the Lok Sabha, the UP government is convening a special session of the legislature on April 30. There is a plan to bring a censure motion against the opposition in it. 10. Pakistan's missile strike on Afghanistan kills 7, injures 75 At least seven people were killed and more than 75 were injured in a series of attacks in eastern Afghanistan’s Kunar Province on Monday, amid rising tensions between Afghanistan and Pakistan.

stories.title: Akhilesh reaches to meet injured BJP MLA:She smiles on seeing him, was burnt during his effigy burning
stories.summary: SP President Akhilesh Yadav suddenly reached Medanta Hospital on Tuesday. He inquired about the well-being of BJP MLA Anupama Jaiswal, who is admitted there. When Akhilesh greeted her with folded hands, Anupama smiled. Akhilesh also spoke to the doctors treating the MLA. Akhilesh shared a photo of the meeting on social media. On which a couplet was written, 'Let the politicians know their duty, my message is love, wherever it reaches.' Anupama, MLA from Bahraich, was immolating effigies of Akhilesh Yadav and Rahul Gandhi on April 25 in protest against the 'Nari Vandan Adhiniyam' (Women's Reservation Bill) failing in Parliament, when she got burnt. Immediately after this incident, Akhilesh posted a video on X. He wrote, 'Those who set fires beware. Arrangements should be made for the treatment of the woman who set the fire.' See 2 photos Akhilesh said- Politics has its place, the importance of human relations has its own place SP chief said, we do not want fire to ignite among society. We want a shower of harmony in society. The healthy tradition of our positive politics has taught us this. That is why we went to meet BJP MLA Anupama Jaiswal. We have wished for her speedy recovery. Politics has its place and the importance of human relations has its place. May goodwill prevail, may harmony prevail! SP Media Cell said - PM and CM should have visited In this matter, SP Media Cell targeted PM Modi and CM Yogi. Wrote on X, even if political parties are different, ideologies are different, but SP chief Akhilesh Yadav is at the forefront of respecting women and promoting harmony. BJP MLA Anupama Jaiswal had accidentally burned herself while setting fire to an effigy of SP chief Akhilesh Yadav. To see her, inquire about her well-being, and wish her good health, the SP chief himself reached Medanta Hospital. He met Anupama, inquired about her well-being, wished her good health, and met her family members. Whereas Prime Minister Modi and Chief Minister Adityanath Bisht should have gone themselves to meet their MLA, but they were busy with the Bengal elections and were criticizing the opposition. The difference between BJP and Samajwadi Party regarding women's safety and 'Nari Vandan' (respect for women) is clear. How the incident happened, read in sequence In Bahraich, on April 25, at 1 PM, BJP workers were protesting regarding the Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam (Women's Power Salutation Act). As soon as the workers set fire to the effigy, the flames flared up and came onto MLA Anupama Jaiswal's face. Her face and hair were scorched. Workers and policemen present at the spot immediately extinguished the fire with a cloth. The MLA was immediately admitted to the district hospital for treatment. From there, she was sent to Medanta. Anupama Jaiswal was the Minister of Basic Education and Women and Child Development for about 2 years during the first term of the Yogi government. See 3 pictures of the incident After her face was scorched, the MLA fled from the spot. Workers and policemen rescued her. Senior journalist said - Akhilesh set a new example Senior journalist Ashok Tripathi, who has covered SP for a long time, says, Akhilesh Yadav has set a new example of political conduct. At the same time, he has tried to send a message to his opponents that his fight is ideological, not personal. Akhilesh Yadav has hit several targets with one arrow. He neither complained nor made any adverse comment when his own effigy was burnt. Anupama is a woman MLA, and he has tried to send a message to women. Akhilesh Yadav fields his close aide Yasir Shah from the Bahraich Sadar seat, from which Anupama Jaiswal is an MLA. In 2022, Anupama Jaiswal won the election by about 4,000 votes. This is a move that even the BJP will not be able to attack, even if it wants to. Because no big BJP leader came to visit Anupama Jaiswal, who has been admitted to the hospital for four days. Now, know about the Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam On April 17, 2026, during a special session of Parliament, the 131st Constitution Amendment Bill related to women's reservation failed in the Lok Sabha. This bill was rejected for the 7th time in 30 years, as the government failed to gather the necessary two-thirds majority to pass it. This time, 298 votes were cast in its favor, while 230 votes were against it. This bill was related to providing 33% reservation for women, along with delimitation. Opposition parties had demanded immediate implementation of the reservation without census and delimitation, while the government presented it by linking it with these. This was the first time in 12 years of governance that the Modi government could not pass a bill in the House. Earlier, Amit Shah had said in an hour-long speech in the Lok Sabha that if these bills are not passed, the opposition would be responsible. After the bill failed, the BJP made it an issue. Protests were held against the opposition in various places.

stories.title: Wife attacks husband with acid in Pilibhit:Victim says he mistook it for hot tea; dispute for 5 years
stories.summary: In Pilibhit on Sunday, a wife threw acid on her husband. The husband was severely burnt by this. Splashes of acid also fell on the wife, injuring her as well. CCTV footage of the incident has also surfaced. The video shows the woman standing at the gate on the second floor. As soon as the husband comes near the gate from the adjacent room, she pours the glass full of acid on him. The husband said - I initially thought she had thrown hot tea. I went to the kitchen and washed my face. Even after this, the burning sensation kept increasing. Then I went to the bathroom and took a shower. After this, the acid went into my mouth. When I tasted something sour, I understood that acid had been thrown. Actually, there has been a dispute between the husband and wife for 5 years. The wife has also filed a case of dowry harassment against the husband. Meanwhile, the husband has accused the wife of having an affair. The matter is from the City Kotwali area. First, see 2 pictures Now the complete matter in detail Hemant (35) lives with his daughter Arya (4) in Khairullah Shah Mohalla. He is a goldsmith by profession. Hemant was married to Shilpi (32), a resident of Lakhimpur, 6 years ago in 2020. Hemant alleges that a year after their marriage, he found out that Shilpi was having an affair with a young man. Hemant also complained about this to his in-laws. After this, he had a quarrel with Shilpi. In 2021, Shilpi filed a case of dowry harassment against Hemant. After this, she packed her belongings and went to her parental home. Hemant said - When I was not at home, Shilpi's lover Vimal used to come to the house. I have also caught both of them red-handed. I also have proof of this. Shilpi repeatedly tried to enter the house Hemant said - Troubled by my wife, I filed for divorce. When Shilpi received the divorce notice in February 2026, the dispute between us escalated. Even after filing the divorce case, Shilpi repeatedly tried to enter my house. During this time, the police also made me sit at the police station for several hours many times. They also issued a challan for disturbing the peace. Wife went to the second floor and threw acid Shilpi reached Pilibhit from her maternal home Lakhimpur around 4 PM on Sunday evening. She started creating a ruckus outside Hemant's house. Hemant called 112. Police also arrived at the scene, but the police returned as there was no female police officer with them. After this, Shilpi forcibly entered Hemant's house. Hemant was on the second floor of the house. There is a meshed gate on the second floor. Hemant's room is adjacent to that gate. As soon as Hemant came out of the room, Shilpi threw acid on him with a glass from outside the mesh. Some acid splashes also fell on Shilpi, due to which she also got burnt. Both Hemant and Shilpi were admitted to the district hospital, where Hemant's condition remains serious. City Kotwal Satyendra Kumar said that an impartial investigation into the matter would be conducted.

stories.title: Uma Bharti says reservation cannot be scrapped:'It will continue untill President's PM families study in govt schools'
stories.summary: Former CM Uma Bharti made a big statement regarding reservation at the valor journey of Raja Hirdeshah Lodhi, organized at Jamburi Maidan in the capital Bhopal. She said reservation is necessary for social equality in the country. Uma Bharti said- Until the families of the President, Prime Minister, and Chief Justice study together in government schools, no one can snatch away reservation. She said that Indian society remained divided on caste lines for a long time, and economic inequalities were deep. In such a situation, reservation is a major effort to reduce that disparity. Equality will come not just through law, but through changes in behavior. When the families of people holding top positions in the country also study in government schools, then real equality will come in both the education system and society. During this, Uma Bharti was welcomed by being presented with a shield and a sword. In the program, Panchayat Minister Prahlad Patel, Tourism Minister Dharmendra Singh Lodhi, Balaghat MLA Anubha Munjare, Pichhore MLA Pritam Lodhi, Banda MLA Virendra Singh Lambardar, Bada Malhara MLA Ram Siya Bharti, Bargi MLA Neeraj Singh Thakur, State President of Lodhi Lodha Mahasabha Jalam Singh Patel, and Kaushalendra Singh, descendant of King Hirdeshah, along with a large number of people from the Lodhi-Lodha community were present. Uma said - Now I will tell you about the second battle for independence. When Modi ji took oath as Prime Minister in 2014, an editor of an American newspaper wrote, 'The British left, but they left behind some 'black British'." We are modernizing, but not Westernizing. When BJP was formed after Jan Sangh, it was called a backward and opposition party. For the first time, one person gave up his chair for the Ram Temple. Another gave up his chair for the tricolor. After this, a community broke the illusion that BJP is an anti-backward party. India will take back PoK Uma Bharti said that power was relinquished in Uttar Pradesh for the Ram Janmabhoomi movement, while in Madhya Pradesh, the post was resigned for the respect of the tricolor. She said that this new freedom is progressing under the leadership of Narendra Modi. India will one day reclaim Pakistan Occupied Kashmir. Pakistan will have to kneel and apologize. She also said that by responding to the Pahalgam incident, India has proven its strength. The third battle for freedom should be for equality Uma Bharti said that in Indian culture, trees, mountains, and even living beings are worshipped, and there is no discrimination of any kind in it. The country has struggled for a long time for independence, but now the third battle for freedom should be fought for the right to equality. Uma said The Lodhi community has a significant population, and governments are formed with their participation. This community has the power to form governments. Pritam said At least one Lodhi CM should be made in India Pichhore MLA Pritam Lodhi said If Hema Malini's Dharmendra can get Bharat Ratna, then why can't our Kalyan Singh get it? Pritam said The world follows where youth leads. When I go out to see the youth, today's youth is found in playing cards. It is found in liquor shops. When we were young, we had two chief ministers from our community. Today there are zero. There should be at least one Lodhi chief minister in India.

stories.title: Mahua Moitra calls IPS Ajay Pal ‘Fair and Lovely babua’:Taunts him, 'Hope your policing skills are better than your dancing skills'
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh encounter specialist IPS Ajay Pal Sharma has been appointed as an observer in West Bengal by the Election Commission. Soon after taking charge, he has come into action. On Monday, he issued a strict warning to Trinamool Congress (TMC) candidate Jahangir Khan. He said that if voters are threatened or intimidated, strict action will be taken and it will be dealt with firmly. He also warned that there should be no later complaints or regrets. A video of IPS Ajay Pal Sharma has also surfaced. He had received complaints that TMC leader Jahangir Khan was allegedly trying to scare voters. Following this, he himself reached the spot. Under his leadership, teams of SSB, FST and QRT carried out raids in the area. Jahangir Khan is considered close to West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee’s nephew Abhishek Banerjee. Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav has called IPS Ajay Pal Sharma an agent of the BJP. He said that at the right time, a deep investigation will be conducted into the alleged wrongdoings of such people working as agents, and strict punishment will follow. On the other hand, the TMC has referred to Ajay Pal Sharma as the “notorious Singham”. The party said that this is West Bengal, not Uttar Pradesh. Know the full story See 2 photos Mahua Moitra attacked Ajay Pal in three posts, TMC MP Mahua Moitra has made three posts against Ajay Pal on X. She made her first post on Monday night at 9:57 PM. In it, she posted a video of Ajay Pal's warning and wrote - My Fair Lovely babua Ajay Pal Sharma (@DripsAjaypal). We are the kind of people who properly deal with your Chhota Fanta and Bada Fanta too. Be a little careful with your heroics. Mahua made the second post on Tuesday morning at 9:30 AM. She wrote- Good to see you enjoying yourself in 'Fanta Cop' style. Stay 'Thanda Thanda, Cool Cool'. Bengal is always Trinamool's. Along with this, two videos were also posted. In the first video, the person who looks like Ajay Pal Sharma is standing in front of a woman and clapping, while the woman is sitting down and doing dance steps. In the second video, the person is seen standing very close to a woman and swaying to the song 'Choli Ke Peeche Kya Hai'. The third post she made at 10 AM. It read - Ajay Pal Sharma, hope your policing skills are better than your dancing skills just saying. Jahangir Khan's reply - The picture is not over yet Jahangir Khan has replied to Ajay Pal Sharma. He said - You started the game, but I will finish it. The picture is not over yet. The match has started. You think you are creating a spectacle with a few CRPF jawans. But if everyone comes together, you people will be blown away. Akhilesh said - Criminals of democracy will not be spared Voting to be held on 142 seats on April 29 Voting for 152 seats in the first phase of the West Bengal Assembly Elections 2026 has already taken place on April 23. During this period, barring minor incidents, the polling remained peaceful. The second phase of voting is scheduled for April 29. Votes will be cast on a total of 142 seats, including Kolkata. Considering the sensitivity of the second phase, the Election Commission has sent 11 new police observers to Bengal. One of them is IPS Ajay Pal Sharma. The results of the assembly elections will be announced on May 4. Now read about Ajay Pal Sharma and Mahua Moitra Ajay Pal Sharma- From Dental Surgeon to Encounter Specialist Ajay Pal Sharma, who became an IPS officer in 2011 after being a dentist, is also known as an 'Encounter Specialist'. In his 15-year career, he has carried out more than 500 encounters. In these, 15 criminals were killed, while others were arrested. Dr. Ajay Pal Sharma, a resident of Ludhiana, Punjab, was a dental surgeon before becoming an IPS officer. He obtained his BDS (Dental Sciences) degree from Government Medical College, Patiala. His younger brother, Amit Pal Sharma, is an IAS officer. The 41-year-old Ajay Pal is currently posted as Additional CP (Law and Order) in Prayagraj. Prior to this, he has served as SP/SSP in five districts. During his 22-month tenure as SP in Jaunpur, he carried out a record 136 encounters. This is the highest number of encounters in any district during an SP's tenure. Commanded these districts He has served as the Superintendent of Police (SP) for Hathras, Shamli, Rampur, and Jaunpur. In 2013, he was posted as ASP during the Kumbh Mela held in Prayagraj. He was also given responsibility as SP Personnel at Police Headquarters and as the head of UP-112. Woman had made serious allegations Ajay Pal Sharma's career has been full not only of successes but also of controversies. In 2020, a woman named Deepti Sharma made serious allegations against him. The woman claimed that Ajay Pal had married her in 2016 and later reneged. This case escalated so much that an FIR was registered against him at Hazratganj police station in Lucknow, and an SIT investigation was also launched. Due to this controversy, his promotion was also stalled for a long time, although he was later given a clean chit. Served as Nodal Officer in Mahakumbh Just before the Mahakumbh, he was appointed as Nodal Officer (Mahakumbh, Prayagraj Commissionerate) in Prayagraj. On December 22, 2024, he was made Additional CP Prayagraj. During this period, he played a significant role in the successful organisation of the Mahakumbh. After the Mahakumbh, he was entrusted with the responsibility of Additional CP (Law and Order), Prayagraj.

stories.title: Legislature’s special session ahead:BJP plans to deploy women ministers; Akhilesh to promote Ragini Sonkar and Naseem Solanki
stories.summary: After the Women's Reservation Amendment Bill failed in the Lok Sabha, the UP government is convening a special session of the legislature on April 30. There is a plan to bring a censure motion against the opposition in it. Through this, the BJP government will try to send a message that Congress and SP did not allow the bill to pass due to their anti-women policies. Meanwhile, the opposition will target the BJP over the timing of bringing the bill. In fact, when the central government brought the amendment bill in the Lok Sabha, election campaigns were underway in 5 states, including Tamil Nadu and West Bengal. The opposition alleged that the BJP government wanted to change the country's electoral map. This bill has been brought keeping in mind the electoral benefits of 2029. Overall, a huge uproar is certain in UP's special session. Before that, know what kind of atmosphere the BJP has created around the Women's Reservation Bill in UP? Protests began in UP from the very next day after the bill failed Immediately after the Women's Reservation Amendment Bill failed in the Lok Sabha on April 17, BJP's women MPs protested against the opposition in the Parliament complex. From the very next day, BJP launched a major campaign in UP to corner the SP and Congress on this issue. CM Yogi and Union Minister Annapurna Yadav held a press conference. A protest rally of women was taken out from the Chief Minister's residence. CM Yogi himself led the rally. During this, many senior leaders including BJP State President Pankaj Chaudhary, Deputy CM Keshav Prasad Maurya, and Brajesh Pathak were present. Government to prioritize women MLAs and ministers BJP has a sufficient majority in both houses. Due to this, the passing of the resolution is considered certain. During the discussion on the censure motion, women MLAs and ministers will be put forward by the ruling party. During this, criminal incidents against women during the SP government will also be mentioned. Additionally, BJP is running a campaign across UP to create an atmosphere against the opposition. Women's wing workers are contacting women door-to-door. Protests and effigy burning programs are being organized in every district. Attempt to consolidate women's vote bank against the opposition Senior journalist Virendranath Bhatt believes that women played a big role in BJP winning the assembly and Lok Sabha elections in UP from 2017 to 2022. The Yogi government is running various schemes for women, including Mission Shakti. The perception has been formed that crimes against women have decreased under the Yogi government. Women can safely go out on the streets. BJP also needs the women's vote bank in the 2027 assembly elections. Through this session, the government is trying to woo the women's vote bank. The Yogi government and the BJP organization are trying to reach out to as many women as possible and tell them that their rights were snatched due to the opposition of SP-Congress. SP called a meeting to formulate strategy Meanwhile, the SP has called a meeting of its legislative party on April 29 to decide its strategy for the special session. Party president Akhilesh Yadav will also be present. Women MLAs from the SP will also lead from the house to the street. During this, cases like Hathras incident, Unnao rape case and gang rape of a student at IIT-BHU can be raised. Regarding the special session, SP MLA Ragini Sonkar says - This is a misuse of the public's hard-earned money. The women who came to the BJP rally themselves didn't know why they had come? They are bringing women onto the streets. Someone's clothes are burning, someone's face is burning. BJP is using women for its political self-interest. Congress said - This is BJP's political stunt Aradhana Mishra, leader of the Congress Legislature Party, says - the reality of BJP has been exposed before women. Women have come to know the truth. Congress's opposition is to conducting delimitation without census. If BJP wants to advance women, then why doesn't it make a woman national president? BJP has played this political stunt due to the West Bengal assembly elections. But, BJP will not get any benefit from it. If politics is played on this by the ruling party in the special session of the assembly, we will oppose it.

stories.title: PM Modi slams SP, Congress in Kashi:Says both parties betrayed women; vows to secure reservation for them
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed women in Bhojpuri. He said, “I bow to the mothers and sisters of Kashi.” He accused Congress, TMC and SP of betraying women once again, adding that these dynastic parties are afraid of women’s strength. He said he would leave no stone unturned to ensure reservation for women. The Prime Minister arrived in Kashi on Tuesday for a two-day visit. At the BLW (Banaras Locomotive Works) ground, he reached the venue in an open jeep among around 25,000 women. He waved and greeted the crowd as he made his way to the stage. At the conference, 44 women from fields such as politics, self-help groups and healthcare were seated on the stage. The Prime Minister laid the foundation stone and inaugurated 163 projects worth ₹6,350 crore. These include the Signature Bridge and a super-speciality hospital at Kabirchaura Divisional Hospital. The Prime Minister also flagged off two new trains. One will run between Varanasi and Pune, while the other will operate from Ayodhya to Mumbai. Meanwhile, on Tuesday, before the PM's arrival, Bengali women blew conch shells at Chausathi Ghat in Kashi. The women said that they are confident of victory in the ongoing elections in Bengal, and this event is being organised in Kashi in that joy. According to BJP sources, the Prime Minister will reach Varanasi by special plane after 4 PM. From the airport, he will land at Bareka helipad by army helicopter. From there, he will reach the rally venue, BLW Ground. Here, the PM will address 40,000 women regarding the non-passage of the Nari Shakti Vandan Amendment Act. The Prime Minister will also seek women's opinions on this act here.

stories.title: Gorakhpur accident during kite flying:Iron rod pierces child’s chest; mother rushes him to hospital with it
stories.summary: In Gorakhpur, a rebar on the roof pierced through the chest and neck of a 14-year-old boy. Actually, Harsh was flying a kite on the roof early in the morning. During this, his foot slipped and he fell onto a rebar protruding from an incomplete pillar on the roof. Harsh started screaming and shouting due to the pain. Hearing her son's scream, the mother reached the roof. She called out to family members. The family informed the police. A rebar cutter was called. He cut the rebar and separated it from the roof. The mother took the child, along with the rebar, to the district hospital. During this, the child kept groaning in pain. A team of doctors removed the rebar after an operation that lasted for about 2 hours. Doctors said - the family acted wisely. They did not try to remove the rebar. Because of this, there was no blood loss. The incident occurred on Monday morning at 9 AM in the Ilahibagh Lala Toli area, under the Tiwaripur police station. Now, understand the whole matter sequentially- Amresh Srivastava has a single-story house in the Lala Toli area of Ilaibagh. He works as a waiter. Some construction on the roof is left incomplete. Rebars are protruding from small pillars. Besides his wife Aditi Srivastava, the family has 3 children, including one girl. Harsh is their eldest son. One room in the house is rented out. Mother Aditi said- On Monday morning, her husband had gone out. Around 9 AM, Harsh was playing on the roof. She scolded him twice and brought him down. After that, she started cooking. Above the stairs leading to the roof, there is a tin shed canopy supported by an 8-foot wall, so that rainwater and sunlight do not fall on the stairs. She said that suddenly Harsh climbed onto the tin shed built over the stairs and started flying a kite. A little while later, she heard his screams. I ran from the kitchen to the roof. I saw Harsh stuck in the rebar of a pillar on the roof. He was writhing in pain. I didn't understand anything, so I called out to the tenant. The child was screaming- Akash Bhaiya, save me Aditi said- My son was saying, 'Akash bhaiya, save me.' Akash is the name of my tenant. Hearing the sound, Akash came upstairs. He said that removing the rebar could lead to death. He informed the police. He called my husband and told him everything. We called a craftsman working in a nearby house and had the rod cut. During this, my son was writhing in pain. He was crying loudly. I rushed Harsh to the district hospital. He was admitted. Where doctors removed the rod after the operation. Dr. V.K. Suman, CMS of the district hospital, said- The iron rod had entered the child's right side of the chest and exited from above the neck. The child's condition was very serious. The entire surgical team was called. An immediate operation was decided upon. The iron rod was removed from the child's body in an operation lasting about two hours. The child's condition is now improving.

stories.title: Ganga Expressway passing through 12 districts to open tomorrow:Travel time will likely to drop from 11 to 6 hours
stories.summary: The Ganga Expressway in UP is ready. PM Modi will inaugurate it on April 29. This 594-kilometre expressway will connect Meerut to Prayagraj. It will change the face of the 12 districts it passes through. The expressway will reduce the 11-hour journey to 6 hours. Meerut to benefit most from Ganga Expressway Meerut is counted among the big industrial cities of UP. Sports goods, readymade garments, and leather products are manufactured here. Until now, its main market was Delhi, because the distance from Delhi to Meerut is about 80 km. With the construction of the Ganga Expressway, products from here will now reach Bulandshahr, Shahjahanpur, Lucknow, Prayagraj, and their surrounding districts. This will benefit both traders and buyers. Manufacturing, logistics, and warehousing will also increase here. This will create thousands of jobs. The expressway in Meerut is a total of 15 kilometers long. It starts from Bijoli village. With the construction of the expressway, land in the vicinity has become expensive. The land rate has increased from two and a half thousand rupees/square feet to 6 thousand rupees/square feet. Logistic cluster to be built in Hapur The Ganga Expressway will also give a new identity to the Hapur district, which was carved out of Ghaziabad in 2011. The district has home furnishing, steel, paper, laminated product, rice, and sugar mills. Through the expressway, doing business from here to Purvanchal will become easier. An Integrated Manufacturing and Logistics Cluster (IMLC) is also to be built here. This is a modern 'Industrial Township' model where all facilities for manufacturing, storing, and dispatching goods will be available in one place. Youth of Bulandshahr will benefit The government is going to develop an industrial corridor in Bulandshahr. For this, 120 hectares of land has been selected along the Ganga Expressway. This will provide employment to the youth who go to Delhi-Ghaziabad in search of jobs, right near their homes once the corridor is built. There is only one train from Bulandshahr to Prayagraj. This expressway will improve connectivity between the two cities. In the coming time, a link expressway will be built to connect the Ganga Expressway with Jewar Airport. 80% of this will be in Bulandshahr. Amroha's sugarcane will get a new identity Sugarcane cultivation is extensive in Amroha. With the express-way operational, transport time will decrease. This will provide traders with markets in new cities. Sugarcane will reach large markets like Delhi, Meerut, and Lucknow quickly. The government is planning to establish industrial corridors and MSME units along the express-way. This will benefit the youth. It will be easier to visit Kalki Vishnu Temple in Sambhal Sambhal is an ancient city of Hindu faith. It houses Lord Kalki Vishnu Temple, Manokamna Temple, Gauri Sahai Temple, and Chamunda Mata Temple. A large number of people visit here from surrounding districts. The express-way will make it easier for devotees visiting here. Wooden items, pottery, and brass products are made in this district. Previously, traders here sold their goods only in Moradabad, Delhi, or local markets. With the commencement of the Ganga Express-way, markets in Shahjahanpur, Lucknow, and Prayagraj will open up. 3 Tehsils of Badaun will be Urbanized The Ganga Expressway is passing through the tehsils of Bisauli, Bilsi, and Dataganj in Badaun. This will increase urbanization in these tehsils. Interchanges have been built in Dataganj and Wazirganj. Due to being along the expressway, compressed biogas plants, LPG bottling plants, food processing units, and cold storages are being built here. Badaun is a major producer of mentha (peppermint). With the start of the expressway, farmers will be able to sell their crops from Delhi to Prayagraj. In the coming time, an industrial corridor is to be built near Dataganj. This will make transportation easier. People of Badaun were dependent on Bareilly for treatment until now, but after the start of the Expressway, they will have the option to go to Lucknow, Meerut, and even Delhi. Sugarcane farmers of Shahjahanpur will benefit An airstrip has been built on a three-and-a-half-kilometer stretch of the Ganga Expressway in Shahjahanpur. It is located in the Jalalabad tehsil area. Last year, 8 fighter jets like Rafale, Jaguar, and Mirage landed here. Now, there are plans to manufacture defense-related items here. Shahjahanpur is known as a sugarcane belt. There are about 4 sugar mills here. These include Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Mill (Tilhar), Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Mill (Maksudaipur), Roza Sugar Mill, and Kesar Enterprises Sugar Mill. The Ganga Expressway will make it easier to send sugar to other states. Nowadays, sugar mills are not only producing sugar but also ethanol. Due to the expressway, ethanol supply to oil company depots will be faster. The airstrip located in Shahjahanpur is near this sugar belt. In the future, if 'cargo facilities' are established here, new avenues will open up for the agricultural products of this region. Land prices in Hardoi increased by up to three times Despite being close to Lucknow, Hardoi district lagged behind in development. This expressway will give it a boost. Interchanges have been built on the expressway at two places in the district - Sandi and Bilgram. This has increased land rates here. Many new hotels, dhabas, petrol pumps, and markets have started to develop. Hardoi has a high production of rice, wheat, and potatoes. Until now, farmers and traders here had limited options to take their produce outside. But now, crops can be transported to other districts more quickly. Industries in Unnao will double Many industries from the industrial city of Kanpur are now shifting to Unnao. The main reason for this is the Ganga Expressway. The UP government is going to develop an industrial corridor along the expressway here. This will benefit the local youth who used to go outside for employment. Despite being located between Lucknow and Kanpur, many parts of Unnao could not be developed. With this expressway, Safipur, Miyaganj, Purwa, Dahi, and Bighapur will be connected to urbanization. This is because interchanges have been built in these areas. Reaching Raebareli AIIMS will be easier There is an AIIMS in Raebareli. Until now, only local people benefited from it. However, with the start of the Ganga Expressway, people from other districts will also be able to get treatment here. The route currently taken by people from Pratapgarh, Prayagraj, and Unnao to reach Raebareli is crowded and jammed. The Ganga Expressway will make the route easier. People traveling from Lucknow to Prayagraj will now be able to go directly from one city to another without entering Raebareli city. Pratapgarh's Amla will also be sold in Delhi Pratapgarh's Amla is famous throughout the country. However, due to lack of proper connectivity, this product was limited to nearby districts. Thanks to the Ganga Expressway, it will be possible to take it to Delhi and sell it. Mango production is also abundant in Pratapgarh. Mango farmers and traders will benefit from this. The Ganga Expressway will lead to the start of real estate and new commercial projects here. Industries will be set up in Soraon-Malaka of Prayagraj The expressway, which starts from Meerut, ends at Judapur Dandu in Prayagraj. Prayagraj city is 25 kilometres away from here. Development will take place here due to the Ganga Expressway. Until now, most industries were in the Naini area, but now they will also be set up in Soraon and Malaka sides. Every year, Magh Mela is held in Prayagraj, Kumbh Mela every 6 years, and Mahakumbh every 12 years. During this period, millions of devotees visit. For people coming from Delhi or the western districts, the Ganga Expressway will be the easiest route. Due to the presence of the Allahabad High Court, it was already a major city. Now it will become even more important.

stories.title: Officer made to do sit-ups calls IAS Association dishonest:Rinku Singh withdraws resignation; says no lure of posting
stories.summary: UP IAS officer Rinku Singh Rahi, who came into the news after doing sit-ups, has withdrawn his resignation. He has submitted a written application to the government for this. When asked about his decision, Rinku Singh said he has no desire for any specific posting and only wants to work. He said the government can assign him work anywhere. He also said that government officials have assured him that such a situation will not happen again. He has been told that he will soon be given a respectful posting. Rinku Singh said- It is wrong to trust the IAS Association. It does not support anyone. The association is the most deceitful. The same thing happened to me as happened to Karna in Mahabharata, just as Karna's earrings were taken away. Rinku Singh Rahi had sent a conditional resignation to the President on March 26. He said that he was getting a salary, but was not getting an opportunity for public service. He had also appealed to be sent back to his old job, i.e., PCS. 44-year-old Rinku was transferred from Shahjahanpur to the Board of Revenue 9 months ago. Since then, he had not received any field posting. Rinku is an IAS officer of the 2021 batch. He still has 16 years of service remaining. Rinku Singh was fired upon on March 26, 2009, during the BSP regime, in which he was hit by seven bullets. Two of these hit his face, disfiguring it. How Rinku Singh was convinced, know here After Rinku's resignation on March 26, there was a stir in the administration. After this, government officials sprang into action. According to sources, an investigation was conducted into Rinku's work during his previous job. His school-college academic documents and caste certificate were also investigated, but no evidence of irregularities was found anywhere. After this, government officials and Anil Kumar, Chairman of the Revenue Council, spoke to Rinku and assured him that his respect would be taken care of in the future. After this, he withdrew his resignation. However, its date has not been revealed. Read exactly what Rinku told Bhaskar after resigning Question - You belong to a Scheduled Caste, did this happen because of that? Rinku: I don't know. I have never thought about this, so I cannot answer. If there were any other officer in my place, they would also have to face this. I want to say that besides the SC caste, there is another caste - the caste of honesty. Honesty is also of two types. One, who only doesn't take money. The other, who works honestly. I am among those who work honestly. Question: You wrote that a parallel system of corruption is running, what is its basis? Rinku: Absolutely right. You must have seen that in many places there is no road, but on paper, the road has been built. This is a system of corruption, which even political people are troubled by. Question: Who is running this system of corruption? Rinku: The bureaucracy itself is running this system of corruption. This system does not work without money. When work is only happening on paper, what does that mean? Question: You haven't received a posting for several months, what do you have to say? Rinku: Perhaps this is the first time since independence that a junior IAS officer has been treated this way. I had already said that if I don't get work, I won't take a salary either. If this happens to a junior IAS officer, what message will it send? I have already faced postings and punishments, but if this happens to a new officer, they will become negative forever. Question- Were you harassed for a posting? Rinku: I was not harassed. I am personally very happy. I am getting time to travel around. I have come to do this job not for personal convenience, but to serve the people. This is a moral issue. My ideals and principles are getting in the way. Read, why Rinku Singh was removed from the SDM post 9 months ago, Rinku Singh Rahi was a Joint Magistrate in Mathura. After being transferred from there, he took charge as Powayan SDM on July 24, 2025, at 2 PM. During this time, he noticed Vijay (38), the clerk of lawyer Agyaram, urinating near the wall inside the premises. He reprimanded him and asked him to use the toilet. The clerk replied to Rinku Singh that the toilets are dirty. At this, the SDM got furious. He started saying that this was the fault of the Tehsil employees. He made the clerk do squats on the spot. Lawyers were protesting in the Tehsil premises regarding some of their demands. Just then, they came to know about the clerk being made to do squats. At this, the lawyers got agitated. They called the SDM to the spot. The SDM told the lawyers that the clerk had made a mistake. At this, the lawyers said that if there is a mistake, then making someone do squats is not right. Can you do squats? At this, Rinku Singh said that there is no shame in it. I can do squats. After this, he did squats 5 times. Know who Rinku Singh Rahi is A resident of Hathras, first became PCS then IAS Rinku Singh Rahi was born on May 20, 1982, in Hathras into a Dalit family. He is a resident of Usva village in Sasni police station area. Rinku, the elder of two brothers, had a father, Saudan Singh Rahi, who supported the family by running a flour mill. Due to the family's weak financial condition, he studied in a government school. After passing 12th grade with good marks, he received a scholarship. With its help, he pursued B.Tech from Tata Institute in Jamshedpur. In 2004, Rinku Singh passed the PCS examination. During his job, he appeared for the UPSC Civil Services examination under the disabled quota. In 2021, he secured the 683rd rank and became an IAS officer. In his family, his wife Sulakha has been a yoga teacher. He has a 10-year-old son, Dhruv Rahi. His paternal uncle, Raghuveer Singh Rahi, was a district president during the BSP regime. He was shot 7 times for exposing corruption After becoming a PCS officer, Rinku Singh's first posting in 2008 was as District Social Welfare Officer in Muzaffarnagar. There, he exposed corruption in scholarships and pensions. Rinku told Dainik Bhaskar - "During the investigation, I found out that 100 crore rupees had been embezzled. Behind this was an entire gang, in addition to a political party." At that time, the BSP government was in power. On March 26, 2009, Rinku was playing badminton with a colleague. Suddenly, two attackers opened fire on him. Rinku Rahi was hit by seven bullets in this. Two of them hit his face. His jaw was dislocated and his face was disfigured. Additionally, one ear was damaged and he lost sight in one eye. Remained hospitalized for a month, staged a protest After this attack, Rinku was taken to a higher center in Meerut. He remained admitted for about a month at Subharti Medical College in Meerut. He returned recovered after the operation. After this, to expose the scam, Rinku sought some information from the department under RTI. However, even after a year, the information was not provided to him. Subsequently, on March 26, 2012, Rinku Rahi started a hunger strike outside the Lucknow Directorate. The police picked up Rinku Rahi from there and sent him to Mental Hospital Lucknow.
