stories.title: UP Board results declared ahead of schedule:Varanasi’s Sakshi tops Intermediate; girls outperform boys across state
stories.summary: The UP Board results were declared on Thursday at 4 pm. A total of 80.38% students passed in Class 12. Shikha Verma from Sitapur topped the state with 97.60%. Her father Jitendra Kumar is a farmer, while her mother Kanti Devi is a homemaker. Shikha aims to become an income tax officer. Topper from Sitapur scores highest marks in state Nandini Gupta from Bareilly and Shriya Verma from Barabanki secured the second position with 97.20% marks each. Two students also shared the third position. Surbhi Yadav from Bareilly and Pooja Pal from Barabanki scored 97%. Surbhi’s father runs a furniture shop. Two students share second and third positions Girls once again outperformed boys in the Class 12 results. While 75.04% boys passed, the pass percentage of girls stood at 86.32%, making it 11% higher than boys. Government colleges performed better than private colleges this year. UP Board Secretary Bhagwati Singh said that students who secured top positions across the state will be honoured by the state government. Girls perform better than boys in results Khushi Dubey, daughter-in-law of Kanpur gangster Vikas Dubey, passed the Intermediate exam with a first division. She scored 60.8%. Khushi is the wife of gangster Amar Dubey, who was killed in an encounter, and is linked to the 2020 Bikru case. Gangster family member passes exam with first division The UP Board Class 10 results were declared on Thursday at 4 pm. Kashish Verma from Sitapur and Anshika Verma from Barabanki topped the state with 97.83% marks each. Aditi from Barabanki secured the second position with 97.50%. Three students shared the third position with 97.33% — Arpita from Sitapur, Rishabh Sahu from Jhansi and Pari Verma from Barabanki. Two girls share top rank with equal marks A total of six students made it to the top three ranks, including five girls. As many as 115 students secured places in the top 10. Sitapur had 13 students, Barabanki 9, Fatehpur 7, while Kanpur Nagar, Etawah and Gonda had six students each in the top list. Out of 68 prisoners who appeared for the exam, 67 passed. Over hundred students feature in top ten list Bhadohi district recorded the best performance, with 95.78% students passing. Lalitpur had the lowest result at 80.22%. Among schools, 87.93% students from government schools passed. The pass percentage was 86.98% in aided schools and 92.32% in self-financed private schools. District-wise performance shows major gap in results In Kashi, the principal of PM Shri Government Queens College broke down in tears after the results were announced, as his student Suryadeep topped the district. In Bareilly, teachers at a school celebrated by dancing with students after the results. Emotional and joyful scenes seen after result announcement Last year, the Class 10 result was declared on April 25 with a 90.11% pass rate. This year, results have been announced in 42 days, making it one of the earliest declarations. In Intermediate (Class 12), girls outperformed boys. In Varanasi, Sakshi topped the district with 94.40%, followed by Vaishali Maurya (92.20%) and Ritu Verma (92%). A total of 45,977 students appeared in the district. Last year, Varanasi recorded an 89.63% pass rate, ranking third in the state after Amethi (92.65%) and Amroha (90.55%). District topper Naman Gupta had scored 461/500 marks.

stories.title: 5 die as tractor-trolley overturns in Lakhimpur:Victims were going to Bahraich for mundan; around 160 passengers in 2 trolleys
stories.summary: 5 people died in Lakhimpur Kheri on Thursday when a tractor-trolley overturned. 15 people were injured in the accident. The condition of 9 remains serious. Two trolleys were tied to one tractor. Due to this, the driver could not balance the tractor. As a result, both trolleys fell into a ditch by the roadside. More than 150 people, riding in both trolleys, were going to Karikot Dev Sthan in Sujauli, Bahraich, for a tonsure ceremony. All the injured, including the deceased, are said to be residents of Shardanagar police station area. The incident occurred in the Padua police station area. 4 pictures of the accident A girl was seen crying and screaming, pleading to save her family. Trolley fell into gorge after losing balance Local people said, two trolleys were attached to the tractor. Due to which the driver was having difficulty balancing. Suddenly, a car came in front of the tractor-trolley. In an attempt to save the car, the tractor-trolley fell into the gorge. We ran to the spot. On the spot, we saw many people trapped under the trolley. While many injured people were scattered on the road. Everyone was trying to save their relatives. We immediately called the police and started the rescue. Now see 2 pictures of the rescue Around 80-90 people were sitting in both trolleys About half an hour after the information, police and ambulance reached the spot. The injured were sent to the hospital. The bodies have been sent for post-mortem. The injured are being treated by the administration. Police have started investigating the matter. A young man, who was going to attend the tonsure ceremony, said, "Two trolleys were attached to a single tractor. About 80-90 people were sitting in both. The accident happened when the driver lost control." stories.title: Haryanvi actor Divyanka Sirohi dies at 30 after sudden collapse:Head injury proves fatal after she fell at Ghaziabad home, family fails to save her life
stories.summary: Haryanvi industry loses Divyanka Sirohi at 30: Actress collapses at Ghaziabad home, suffers fatal head injury before reaching hospital Haryanvi actor Divyanka Sirohi, 30, died late on April 21 after collapsing at her residence in Ghaziabad. According to her family, she suddenly felt unwell around 8 pm, lost balance and fell to the floor, sustaining a severe head injury. She was rushed to a hospital but was declared dead on arrival. Her last rites were performed in Ghaziabad on Wednesday morning. Family recounts final moments Her brother Himanshu said the fall caused internal head injuries and bleeding. By the time younger brother Deepanshu reached her, her body had turned cold. Doctors confirmed her death at the hospital, leaving the family in shock. Career across Haryanvi music industry Divyanka had featured in over 50 Haryanvi songs and worked with prominent names such as Masoom Sharma, Amit Saini Rohtakiya and KD. She also enjoyed a strong digital presence with 1.3 million followers on Instagram, reflecting her popularity among younger audiences. Key highlights from her career and life Early life and education background Born on November 19, 1996 in Bulandshahr, Divyanka grew up in a family now based in Ghaziabad. She completed a B.Com from Chaudhary Charan Singh University in Meerut, followed by an MBA from Sikkim and a B.Ed from Gurugram. Her father Gajendra is a transporter, while her mother Anita is a homemaker. She is survived by two brothers, Himanshu and Deepanshu, and sister Jasmeet. Rise from social media to stage recognition Divyanka had said in an interview that her journey began on TikTok, where a video on Sunanda Sharma’s song went viral, drawing nearly 20 million views and helping her gain five million followers. She later entered the Haryanvi industry after briefly working in 2018. She often credited her family’s support and maintained a close-knit working approach, frequently accompanied by her brother on shoots. Personal views and industry journey Tributes pour in from industry peers Haryanvi artist Manjeet Panchal mourned her death on social media, calling her a “remarkable artist” and expressing grief over her untimely passing. Divyanka had also shared stage space with singer Masoom Sharma at a live show in Sirsa, where she received a warm reception from the audience.

stories.title: ‘Gave me alcohol before sex, then refused marriage’:Lucknow SGPGI woman doctor claims; says partner gave pills to prevent pregnancy
stories.summary: A woman doctor at SGPGI in Lucknow has accused a fellow doctor of cheating her with a false promise of marriage and forcing her into a physical relationship. She has filed an FIR at PGI Kotwali. The resident doctor, who is from West Bengal and is pursuing her MD, said the accused, Dr Sachin Gupta, first approached her in 2024 and proposed friendship. She alleged that he later came close to her by promising marriage, after which they entered into a physical relationship. She claimed that after the first time, he began forcing her into sex regularly. Before every encounter, he allegedly made her drink alcohol and then gave her pills, which he ordered online. The woman said she later came to know from friends that the accused had relations with several other women. When she confronted him, he allegedly told her that many women had come and gone in his life and refused to marry her. She also accused him of spreading rumours about her inside the SGPGI campus, damaging her reputation. She said attempts by the Vishakha Committee and common friends to resolve the matter failed, as the accused did not agree to any settlement. Doctor absconds after FIR is registered The victim female doctor has said that she is now in depression. She became addicted to drugs. The accused doctor Sachin Gupta has now started living in with another girl. When she filed a complaint at PGI Kotwali, Sachin Gupta came to know about it. Since then, he has not been seen on campus. In the matter, a case has been registered at SGPGI Kotwali based on the complaint of the victim female resident doctor. According to the police, raids are being conducted to interrogate the accused doctor. He has not been found on campus for 2 days. Now, raids will also be conducted at his Delhi address. Read the full case A female doctor working in the Radiodiagnosis department of SGPGI, Lucknow, has accused Delhi-based doctor Sachin Gupta of forced sex, forcing unnatural sex, giving her alcohol, and arranging abortions by ordering medicines online. The female doctor also stated that she was excellent in her studies. Sachin ruined her by getting into a relationship with her. Now he lives with another girl. Whereas, the female doctor had already informed her family about their relationship. The victim has identified herself as belonging to a Scheduled Caste. Knocked on many doors for justice The victim filed a complaint with the police against the accused doctor on February 24, 2026. Subsequently, she appealed to the Vishakha Committee on March 16, the One Stop Center on March 24, and the Women's Commission on March 30, but no hearing took place anywhere. After repeatedly running around for two months, a case was registered on Tuesday night. SGPGI Inspector Dhirendra Singh stated that the Vishakha Committee's report has not been received yet. Currently, a case has been registered and the victim's statement has also been recorded. The accused doctor Sachin Gupta is being searched for. Now read the victim's story Wrote - Ordered contraceptive pills online The victim wrote in the complaint given to the police - I live in the resident hostel of the Radiodiagnosis department. Resident Dr. Sachin Gupta, who works in my department, had physical relations, after which he forcibly gave me a contraceptive pill ordered online. When I found out about his relations with other girls and asked him, he threatened to kill me and distanced himself. He is constantly defaming me on campus. I am being physically and mentally harassed. Told her ordeal in writing to the Women's Commission The victim narrated her ordeal in writing to the Women's Commission. She stated - Sachin used to try various ways to impress me. He used to keep an eye on me, where I was going, what I was doing. After this, he started increasing his closeness with me. After many days, he gained my trust and proposed marriage. After that, our relationship became quite strong. We often met. During that time, Sachin had physical relations. I told my family about my and Sachin's relationship. My family also agreed to our marriage. Everything was going well, but after some time, Sachin started pressuring me for unnatural sex. When I refused, he started getting angry and distancing himself from me. During this time, he started living in with another girl from the same department. Attempted suicide in December 2025 All these things had a bad effect on me and I started living in depression. Controlling myself a lot, I tried to talk to him in February 2025 to improve our relationship. At this, Sachin immediately abused me and strangled me. He pushed me down while uttering casteist abuses. This also caused me injuries. After this incident, I started feeling sad and gradually became addicted to drugs. I was so troubled that in December 2025, I attempted suicide. At that time, my friends broke down the hostel door and saved me. Was excellent in studies, now no one is talking to me Sachin had told everyone in the department about our relationship. Because of this, I feel socially humiliated when such a situation arises. I have always been excellent in studies. I was always serious about my studies. I never had an interest in any other activity. Now, after Sachin did this, not only the doctors of this department but also doctors from other departments have stopped speaking and interacting with me. He is now making other people on campus addicted to drugs as well.

stories.title: UP Board Class 12 results out today:47,815 students appeared for the exam in Lucknow at 121 centers; how to check results
stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Board of Secondary Education will release the Intermediate result on Thursday. This time, the result will decide the future of 47,815 students. The board will announce the result at 4 PM on the official websites upmsp.edu.in and upresults.nic.in. This year, 121 centers including the Model Jail were set up in Lucknow for the board examination. A total of 51,134 students had registered for the Intermediate examination, out of which 47,815 appeared for the exam, while 3,319 students remained absent during the examination. With the release of the result, the students' wait will end and their paths regarding further studies and career will become clear. Lucknow's result in 2025 In the 12th board examination in the year 2025, only 81.17% of the total students from Lucknow were successful. Whereas in 2014, this figure was 90.49%. In this regard, a decline of about 9% was also recorded. Ayush became the Lucknow topper by scoring 92.8% marks. Evaluation Completed in Record Time This year's board examinations were conducted between February 18 and March 12. After successful organization, the evaluation of answer sheets was completed in just 15 working days between March 18 and April 4. Strict instructions were also given to maintain the quality and reliability of the evaluation process. Failed Students Can Also Pass According to Bhagwati Singh, Secretary of the Board of Secondary Education, if any student is not satisfied with their marks after the results, they need not be disappointed. The board will provide facilities like scrutiny and compartment.

stories.title: FIR against 46 SP leaders in Ghazipur stone-pelting case:2 MLAs among accused; multiple injured in violence including ex-minister, SHO
stories.summary: After the ruckus that occurred on Wednesday between the SP delegation and villagers in Ghazipur, police have registered an FIR against 46 SP leaders and 200 unknown persons. The accused include two SP MLAs and the district president. Those involved in stone-pelting and creating disturbance are being identified based on video footage. Actually, on April 15, the body of 16-year-old Nisha Vishwakarma, a resident of Katriya village in Karanda police station area, was found in the river near Jamania bridge. Police investigation revealed a case of murder in a love affair. Following this, on April 19, police registered a murder case and arrested one accused youth. Since the girl was from the Vishwakarma community and the accused from the Brahmin community, the atmosphere in the village was tense. Meanwhile, on Wednesday, an SP delegation reached the village to meet the victim's family. However, the villagers were not in favor of giving this issue a political color. On the other hand, when police stopped the SP workers outside the village, a clash with police first began. When the stone pelting started, villagers also got injured and then the angry villagers started pelting stones. In this, SP's former minister Ram Asare Vishwakarma, Station House Officer Santosh Pathak along with several policemen, villagers and SP workers were injured. SP Dr. Iraj Raja claims that the stone pelting was initiated from the SP side. Action is being taken against those who created the ruckus based on video footage. In view of the tension in the village, besides police from two stations, a PAC contingent has also been deployed. Visuals of the stone pelting and chaos that took place on April 22... Person whom Akhilesh Yadav called a BJP worker made allegations Former CM Akhilesh Yadav posted a video on social media regarding the violence that occurred in Katriya village. In it, a policeman can be seen being hit by a stone on his head. The injured policeman is being carried away by his colleagues. The SP chief wrote, BJP's anarchic elements are now directly attacking the police as well, because they know that the arrogant BJP government is their protector. Now will the police also be called victims? If so, then we will say that one more category has been added to the P in PDA and that is 'Victim Police'. Youth said, ‘SP workers had pelted stones’ However, the young man he mentioned in the post as his worker was a villager from the same village. He said in his statement that he is not associated with any political party. He accused Samajwadi Party workers of stone pelting. Injured youth Suresh Singh said - I am not any SP worker. Former CM Akhilesh Yadav has called me an SP worker on social media. This is completely false. I am a resident of Katriya Panchayat. I am not from any political party. SP workers pelted stones at us. Due to which my head got injured. Against whom has the case been registered? In the case of the riot that occurred in Kataria village, Karanda Station House Officer Santosh Pathak filed an FIR by submitting a complaint late Wednesday night. In the FIR, Jangipur MLA Virendra Yadav, Sadar MLA Jaykishan Sahu, and District President Gopal Yadav have been named. Besides this, Panchu Yadav (District Panchayat Member), Satya Yadav (District Panchayat Member), Pankaj Yadav (District Panchayat Member), Sunil Yadav, Manish Yadav, Anil Yadav, Vikky Yadav, Upkar Yadav alias Sintu Yadav, Prahlad Baudh, Abhishek Kumar, Ashish Yadav, Babul Gaud, Shubham Gaud, Sheru Gaud, Mohan Kumar, Upendra Yadav, Vignath Yadav, Lal Babu Yadav, Subhash Yadav, Jeevan Yadav, Satyendra Yadav, Mohammad Irfan, Shah Mohammad, Sitanshu Kumar Gaud, Amitesh Ram, Suryakant Yadav, Mithun Yadav, Anil Yadav, Santosh Yadav, Harikesh Yadav, Ashish alias Mugnu, Shishu Yadav (Block President), Aamir Ali (Former Students' Union General Secretary), Taukir Khan, Bindu Bala Bind, Reena Yadav, Nisha Pal (Women's Council District President), Shyambihari, Mahesh Yadav, Anish Yadav, Gautam Yadav, Upendra Yadav (Second) and Vivek Yadav (Journalist) have also been made accused. 200 unknown persons have also been made accused. Complete sequence of events A SP delegation was going to meet the family of Nisha Vishwakarma in Katriya village on Wednesday. When the SP delegation reached outside the village at 12 noon, the police tried to stop them. Actually, the villagers had objected to the SP members coming to the village. The villagers alleged that SP people had submitted a memorandum to the DM-SP fabricating a false and concocted story of gangrape, which tarnished the family's image. Whereas the police had already arrested one accused and sent him to jail. Meanwhile, after being stopped by the police, former minister Ram Asare Vishwakarma, MLA Virendra Yadav, MLA Jaykishun Sahu, district president Gopal Sahit, and several dozen SP members who were part of the SP delegation sat on a dharna. A woman from the family was called for talks to meet the SP delegation. But before that, a scuffle started between the SP members and the police. Meanwhile, stone pelting suddenly began. Some stones also hit the villagers. After this, the villagers became aggressive and heavy stone pelting started. Suddenly started stone pelting caused chaos all around. People on both sides were injured due to stone hits. Former minister Ram Asare Vishwakarma, MLA Dr. Virendra Yadav, women worker Reena Yadav, Bindu and several others were injured. Station in-charge Santosh Pathak also suffered a head injury. All the injured were taken to Ghazipur Medical College. Meanwhile, seeing the escalating chaos, police force from nearby stations and PAC were called. Senior police officers reached the spot and the situation was brought under control. Situation deteriorated due to delegation's visit SP Dr. Iraj Raja said - Police tried to stop the SP members when they arrived without permission. Then the SP members started a protest. Amidst sloganeering and pushing and shoving, the situation deteriorated and stone pelting started between around 1:30 to 2 pm. The stone pelting was started by SP members, after which the villagers started throwing stones. The SP said, The situation is currently under control. Considering the tension, police force and PAC have been deployed in the village. Accused are being identified based on footage.

stories.title: Live-in couple's bodies found in locked room in Noida:Had been living together for 3 years; family was unaware of their relationship
stories.summary: In Greater Noida, the bodies of a girlfriend and boyfriend have been found in a locked room. Both were living together as husband and wife in a rented house. Late Wednesday night, neighbours noticed a foul smell. Following this, the police were informed. When police broke down the door and entered, the boy's body was found hanging from a noose, while the girl's body was lying on the floor. In the preliminary investigation, police are suspecting murder followed by suicide. The case is from Tuglpur village in Knowledge Park. Police stated the young man's name is Guddu Paswan alias Golu (30) and his live-in partner's name is Jyoti (24). Both had been living together for three years. When police spoke with the young man's family, it was revealed that they had no information about his marriage. Jyoti worked in housekeeping at a private hospital. However, she had not been going to work for 20 days. Guddu was unemployed. Neighbors reported that both had not been seen for two days. In this situation, it is believed that the bodies are two days old. There were frequent disputes between the two over Guddu being unemployed. After Jyoti left her job, household expenses became difficult, which led to increased quarrels. According to the station in-charge, both families have been informed. The bodies have been sent for post-mortem. The case is being investigated from all aspects. DCP Greater Noida Praveen Ranjan Singh said that on the night of April 22, 2026, information was received that a person had committed suicide in Tuglpur village. As soon as the information was received, Knowledge Park police station reached the spot. The investigation revealed that Guddu Paswan alias Golu, who lived on the third floor of a house in Surendra Nagar, hanged himself from a fan in the room. Meanwhile, the body of his female friend Jyoti was found on the floor in the room. The police called the forensic team to the spot and conducted an investigation. After that, the panchnama of the bodies was filled and sent for post-mortem. The police are investigating all aspects of the case. The family members have also been informed and further legal action is underway.

stories.title: Varanasi 12th hottest city in country, fourth in UP:Temperatures cross 42°C, heatwave persists with slight relief likely after April 28
stories.summary: Varanasi is reeling under a sustained spell of extreme heat, with temperatures holding above normal levels for the fourth straight day. On Thursday, the maximum temperature settled at 42.2 degrees Celsius, intensifying discomfort across the city. The India Meteorological Department has indicated that the prevailing heatwave conditions are likely to continue until April 26, with only a marginal possibility of light rain or drizzle around April 28 offering limited respite. Temperature surge keeps city on edge The relentless rise in temperature has begun to disrupt daily life, with residents struggling to cope with prolonged exposure to harsh sunlight. People are increasingly stepping out with covered heads and protective gear to shield themselves from the blazing sun. Public movement has thinned, particularly during peak afternoon hours, reflecting the growing severity of the weather. State and national heat rankings worsen Varanasi’s position on the heat index has also worsened significantly. On Wednesday, the city ranked as the fourth hottest in Uttar Pradesh based on maximum temperature readings. Prayagraj topped the state with a scorching 43.7 degrees Celsius. • Varanasi recorded 42.2°C on Thursday • Ranked 4th hottest in Uttar Pradesh • Ranked 12th hottest city nationally Across the country, Varanasi stood at the 12th position among the hottest cities. Jharsuguda in Odisha recorded the highest temperature at 44.6 degrees Celsius, underscoring the widespread impact of the heatwave. Markets fall silent under afternoon heat The soaring temperatures have had a visible impact on economic activity as well. Markets across the city reported reduced footfall, with a noticeable lull during afternoon hours. Traders and vendors have been forced to adjust their schedules as the intense heat keeps customers indoors. Zoo authorities alter animal diet The heatwave has not spared animals either, prompting authorities at Sarnath Mini Zoo to take preventive measures. Special dietary changes have been introduced for animals such as deer and barasingha, aimed at helping them cope with the rising temperatures. • Water-rich foods like watermelon, cucumber and gourd introduced • Birds and other animals also given modified diets • Efforts focused on maintaining hydration and cooling Cooling measures stepped up for wildlife Forest Guard Ramdatt Singh said regular water spraying is being carried out to provide relief to animals in enclosures. Drinking water arrangements have been strengthened to ensure adequate supply. In the deer park, animals are being fed green grass, neem leaves and cooling fruits like melon and cucumber three times a week to help regulate body temperature. • Water sprayed periodically in enclosures • Drinking water availability ensured round the clock • Cooling diet provided multiple times a week With heatwave conditions expected to persist for a few more days, both residents and authorities remain on high alert, bracing for continued discomfort until weather conditions ease.

stories.title: Huge demand for ACs, fridges and coolers in Gorakhpur:Showrooms crowded; shopkeepers claim 25% increase in sales
stories.summary: As the heat increases in Gorakhpur, the demand for ACs, fridges and coolers has suddenly surged. Crowds of customers are flocking to the city's electronics shops and people are shopping extensively. According to shopkeepers, ACs and fridges are selling the most at this time. 10-15 ACs are being sold daily from each shop. Rajesh Kumar, operator of New Rajesh Electronics located at Golghar, said that sales have picked up pace in the last one week. Shopping has increased with the rising heat as well as the beginning of the wedding season (lagan). 1.5 Ton Split AC Most Preferred According to shopkeepers, people are now giving more priority to ACs instead of coolers and fans. Especially the 1.5 ton split AC is in highest demand. 15-20 ACs are being sold in a day. Along with this, single door fridges and stand coolers are also selling well. Demand for Budget Friendly Single Door Fridges According to Vishal, an employee at LG Store, many types of modern fridges are available in the market, but most customers prefer single door fridges. The reason for this is its affordability, which easily fits into the budget of common people. Single door fridge is budget friendly Meanwhile, Vishal, a worker at LG Store, said that although there are many types of new fridges available in the market, the first choice of most people remains the single door fridge. It is also budget friendly. Mini fridge also becomes a favorite option With the increasing heat, people are also buying mini fridges according to their needs. Especially students and people who live away for studies or work prefer it more. It is a better option for small rooms and limited space. Also, its use is increasing in offices, schools and small institutions. The starting price of mini fridge is said to be around 9,000 rupees. Mini fridge is the choice of those living away from home He said that due to increasing heat, people are buying and taking mini fridges according to their requirements. This benefits those people more who have less space. Also, students and people living in rented rooms away from home are preferring it more. Apart from this, it is also more useful for most offices, schools or small institutes. Its starting price is 9,000 rupees. Table cooler gives more air He said that if we talk about coolers, most people prefer to buy table coolers. Because it gives air to a greater distance. Also, it provides more cooling. Water can also be filled in it in larger quantities at once. Which runs for a long time. Sales of Stand Coolers Also Increased Rajesh Kumar says that people are buying more stand coolers from my store. Because it doesn't require a separate table to place it. You can stand it wherever you want. Also, it is movable. People like this feature more. 75% sales expected Vishal says that if last year the sales of these items were 50 to 60%, then this time the way the heat has started, the kind of enthusiasm being seen from customers. From that, 70-75 percent is expected. People who had not bought till now. Due to increasing heat, they are buying this year. Cannot work without AC - Abhay Abhay Kumar Yadav, who came to buy an AC, said that the heat has increased so much that now work cannot be done without AC. That's why this time I had to buy it. I have bought a 1.5 ton three star AC. Umesh Kumar said, ‘Cold water is necessary in summer’ Meanwhile, Umesh Kumar Sahni said that the heat has increased, that's why I have come to buy a fridge. At this time, work cannot be done without cold water. Also, various items kept at home get spoiled quickly. That's why buying a fridge has become necessary. Electric items and their rates (in ₹)

stories.title: Bear eats 8 kg of ice cream at Gorakhpur zoo:Temperature soars to 42 degrees; public avoids going outside
stories.summary: The heat wave continues in Gorakhpur. The temperature has been at its peak for the past few days. Dusty hot winds are also blowing at a speed of 30 to 35 kilometers per hour. Due to which people are in distress. Meanwhile, special care is also being taken of animals in this scorching heat. To escape the heat, bears were seen enjoying special fruit ice cream at the zoo. Apart from this, considering the severe heat, the DM has ordered to change the timings of all schools from Class 1 to 12th. Now classes will be held only from 7:30 AM to 12:30 PM. Relief may be available next week According to meteorologist Kailash Pandey, people will have to face intense heat and hot winds for the next one week. The maximum temperature is expected to remain around 42 degrees Celsius. Clouds and light rain are expected next week, which will provide relief. 8 Kg fruit ice cream prepared in a bucket To protect from the heat, special ice cream was arranged for the bear at the zoo. Cucumber, banana, orange, watermelon and other fruits were placed in a bucket and water was added to it. Then it was put in the freezer to make ice cream. The bear ate it with great relish. This sight was worth watching. People's troubles increased Meanwhile, the troubles of people who are forced to go out in the harsh sunlight have increased. To protect themselves from the heat, people are using umbrellas, sunglasses, dupattas, gloves, gamchas and various other items. Along with this, they are seen relying on juice to stay hydrated.

stories.title: Soldier kills wife for opposing his affair:Strangled her to death in Bareilly; son demands punishment for absconding father
stories.summary: 'Papa has killed Mummy. Papa had been hiding in Bareilly for several days, but lied to us saying he was on duty in Punjab. Yesterday he came home at a time when both of us brothers had gone to school. Taking advantage of the opportunity, he took Mummy's life.' This is what 14-year-old innocent Drishya says. Who lost his mother and exposed his father's reality to the world. After their mother's death, Drishya and his younger brother Harsh are completely shattered. Actually, on April 21, in Vaishnodhaam Colony located in Subhashnagar, Bareilly, Geeta, wife of soldier Bharat Singh, was murdered in broad daylight by strangulation at home. When the CCTV cameras installed outside the house were examined, a suspicious person was seen entering at 11:17 AM with his face covered and holding an umbrella. An hour later, the same person came out. When the police showed this footage to elder son Drishya, he screamed. He revealed that this person was none other than his father Bharat Singh. Police also showed the CCTV to Sachin Kumar Yadav, Drishya's maternal cousin who lives in the neighborhood. He also identified the accused. Sachin has filed a named FIR for murder against Bharat Singh, his father and brother on Wednesday. According to the nephew, Bharat Singh had an illicit relationship with a woman. When opposed, he murdered his wife Geeta. The accused is currently absconding. Police are engaged in searching for him. First see these 2 CCTV images... First understand the entire matter in a sequential manner... Bharat Singh (37), a resident of Vaishnodham Colony in Subhash Nagar, is in the army. He is posted in Firozpur, Punjab. His wife Geeta (32) used to manage the household. They have two sons, Drishya (14) and Harsh (12). Geeta's nephew Sachin Kumar Yadav and niece Sheetal Yadav live in a rented house in the neighborhood. On April 20, Geeta had told Sheetal that her uncle was coming. So she should bring the children from school. On April 21, both children had gone to their school as usual. Before bringing them from school, Sheetal reached to meet her aunt. She knocked on the door several times, but there was no response from inside. When a lot of time had passed, she pushed the gate. The gate opened. When she went inside, she saw that Geeta's body was lying on the ground. Seeing this, she screamed and immediately informed her brother Sachin and family members. They called the police. Then the investigation of the case began. 'Definitely go to school tomorrow', father told Drishya on the phone When the Dainik Bhaskar team reached the affected children, the scene there was very emotional. Geeta's elder son Drishya told that Papa had been in Bareilly for many days. However, he did not let any hint of this reach home. A day before the incident, Papa's phone call came. He repeatedly said the same thing, 'Tomorrow both of you brothers must go to school.' 'Used to beat mother mercilessly with sticks and kicks and punches' 14-year-old Drishya and 12-year-old Harsh, both are students of Army School. Drishya studies in 9th class and Harsh in 7th class at Army School. Drishya said that his father never loved his mother. Whenever he came home, he would beat mother mercilessly with sticks and kicks and punches. He would never talk to mother even on the phone, only kept in touch with the children. The accused had taken leave from the unit by making an excuse of a wedding Vinay Kumar, a relative of the deceased Geeta, said that uncle (Bharat Singh) had told him on the phone that they were in Jammu. They were leaving from there. However, when the officers from uncle's unit reached home, they informed that Bharat Singh has been on leave since March 17. He had taken leave by showing a wedding card. Vinay said that his uncle's location was found in Dadri at 12 midnight last night and in Bareilly at 1 pm today. 'Aunt would not open the door for any stranger' Anuj Kumar, a relative of Geeta Singh's nephew who was present at the post-mortem house, said that aunt would not open the door for any stranger. That's why the killer used an umbrella to hide his identity and entered when he got the opportunity. Geeta's maternal home is in Rohri, Dataganj, Badaun. Her in-laws' place is in Mallapur, Moosajhag. SP Manush Pareek said- In the case of the woman's murder in Vaishnodham Colony, the accused has been identified through CCTV footage and surveillance. The accused is the woman's husband himself. He is a soldier by profession. He entered the house in disguise and committed the crime. Several police teams are conducting raids to arrest him. He will be arrested soon.

stories.title: Adulterated food crisis in UP:Paneer made with Urea, chalk mixed in flour; food dyes pose cancer risk
stories.summary: Chalk powder is being mixed in flour. Red chili and turmeric are being openly sold in the market by mixing synthetic dye. Paneer made from urea, palm oil and detergent is being sold for consumption. This is not the condition of just one district, but of the entire UP. This truth has come to light in more than 1.76 lakh surveys/raids conducted in 11 months by the Food Safety and Drug Administration (FSDA). Food that provides taste and health is now causing diseases. Doctors say eating adulterated food for a long time has a bad effect on kidneys and liver. It can even cause cancer. We spoke with Dr. Kripa Ram, Associate Professor of Chemistry at BHU, about the chemicals being mixed in food items and their harmful effects. He Here's the report… Increasing weight with chalk, whitening with broken rice In recent days, FSDA raided flour mills in several districts including Bulandshahr and Firozabad. It was revealed that chalk powder and broken rice were being mixed in wheat flour at many places. Chalk was being used to increase weight and make the flour white and shiny. Similarly, adulteration with broken rice not only brings whiteness to the bread, but also reduces the cost of flour. The rate of broken rice in the market is 12 to 15 rupees per kilo, while the price of wheat is more than 20 rupees. Harm- Eating bread made from adulterated flour causes digestion problems. Long-term consumption can lead to diseases like stones. Identify Adulteration- To identify adulteration of chalk (calcium carbonate), mix one spoonful of flour in a glass of water. Add a few drops of lemon juice or vinegar from the top. If gas bubbles rise in the water, then chalk or lime has been added. Pure flour will settle in the water and will not show any reaction. Risk of Cancer from Sudan Dye Adulteration Synthetic dyes like Sudan First, Second and Third are mixed in red chili powder. Usually these are used in making plastic, candles, shoes and floor polish. Since these colors are cheap and give chili a bright red color, adulterators use them freely. Harm- These colors are 'carcinogenic', meaning their consumption can cause cancer. They also have a bad effect on the liver and kidneys. In UP, the highest number of cases of adulteration in chili powder have been found in Western UP and the Kanpur-Agra region. Identify adulteration- Dr. Kripa Ram, Associate Professor of Chemistry at BHU, explains that Sudan dye is an oil-based color. It does not dissolve in water immediately, but dissolves very quickly in acetone. To identify adulteration, take a little red chili powder in a glass bowl. Add nail polish remover (which contains acetone) to it. If the solution immediately turns dark red, then Sudan dye has been mixed in. Mixing lead-containing chemicals for bright color Turmeric powder is adulterated with 'Metanil Yellow'. This is a type of dye. It is used for coloring cloth, paper, leather, etc. Apart from this, lead chromate (lead-containing yellow color) is also adulterated. This makes the color of turmeric powder bright yellow. Lead chromate is quite cheap. Its color also matches natural turmeric. Due to this reason, adulterators use it. Harm- It affects the 'neurotransmitters' of the brain. This can reduce learning ability and memory. It can have a bad effect on children's mental development, while in adults it increases the risk of heart disease. During pregnancy, it can damage the organs of the fetus. Identify Adulteration- Add a little water to turmeric and mix in a few drops of lemon (acid). If the water color immediately turns deep pink or purple, then it contains Metanil Yellow. To identify Lead Chromate, put turmeric in water. If it immediately releases a deep yellow color and shiny particles settle at the bottom, then it contains Lead Chromate adulteration. Fake Paneer Made by Mixing Flour and Acid Nowadays fake paneer is being openly sold in the market. It doesn't contain even a trace of milk. It is made from vegetable oil, flour, acetic acid, chemicals and urea. In Meerut's Nagla Kumbha village on April 16, 28 quintals of adulterated paneer, more than 5 thousand liters of fake milk, 1100 liters of palm oil and chemicals were recovered. This paneer was being supplied to Delhi-NCR and Uttarakhand. Two separate FIRs have been registered in the case. Harm- Due to detergent and urea, serious infections, ulcers and food poisoning can occur. Problems like vomiting, diarrhea and stomach pain are immediately visible. Long-term use has a bad effect on the filtration system (kidney-liver). This increases the risk of 'liver cirrhosis'. Identify adulteration- Boil a piece of paneer in water and let it cool. Then add 2-3 drops of iodine tincture. If the color of paneer turns blue or black, then it is adulterated. Apart from this, check by rubbing with hands. Real paneer will break and crumble like khoya (mawa). On the other hand, paneer made from detergent or urea will start stretching like rubber or will feel too hard. Rs 55.34 crore in fines collected in 11 months According to FSDA, adulteration occurs in different food items in different areas of UP. Western UP can be called the stronghold of adulteration business. Kanpur and Agra are at the top in cases of adulteration in spices. Meanwhile, Bareilly, Moradabad, Meerut, Agra, Aligarh are ahead in adulteration in milk and dairy products. Minister said, ‘Department given free hand’ Bhaskar spoke with UP's Minister of State for Food Safety (Independent Charge) Dayashankar Mishra. He says, ‘Earlier in UP, campaigns against adulteration used to be limited to festivals. Now they are being run throughout the year. From April 2025 to February 2026, in 11 months, a fine of approximately 55.34 crore rupees has been collected.’ 'The department has been given a free hand to take action when irregularities are found. Major action has been taken on adulteration of dairy products in Ghaziabad and Meerut. FIRs have also been filed. Those who play with people's health will not be spared.'

stories.title: 'Blue drum' murder accused arrive in court with different looks:Muskaan wears Rudraksha and bracelets, Sahil with French cut beard
stories.summary: In Meerut's sensational Saurabh Rajput murder case, the look of accused Muskaan-Sahil has changed. When they appeared in court after 13 months out of jail, their look had transformed. Muskaan's complexion has become fairer than before. Her hands and feet had nail paint on the nails. She had a pearl bracelet on her hand. There was a 'rudraksh mala' around her neck. Meanwhile, Sahil's hair was short. He has a friends bracelet on his hand. His mustache and beard have become very light. He has kept a French cut beard. Actually, on Tuesday, the accused Muskaan-Sahil in the murder case presented their side in the district court on April 21 (Tuesday). Judge Anupam Kumar asked both of them 32-32 questions. Both said - we are being falsely implicated in Saurabh Rajput's murder. During the hearing, people saw both in their new look. Before going to jail, Sahil had very long hair. He used to tie a bun on his head. He had dreadlocks. His hair was up to two and a half feet long. He had a grown beard and mustache on his face. He used to consume drugs day and night. But he has started looking healthier, smarter and fitter than before. He is away from drugs. His hair is short and he has started wearing a cap. His beard and mustache are also short. On the other hand, before going to jail, muskaan used to wear western clothes more often. She also used to roam around with Sahil. She didn't perform worship rituals. But after going to jail, she has started performing worship rituals. She has started wearing religious items. Sahil will present his defense on April 28 On Tuesday, April 21, the District Judge asked Sahil-muskaan during questioning whether they wanted to present their defense. Sahil answered in the affirmative. He said he wants to present his side, he will prove his innocence. Now the case has a date set for April 28. It is believed that on this day, the defense will present some witness or evidence in court to prove that Sahil was in Delhi, not Meerut, on the night of Saurabh's murder. There is talk that Sahil's elder brother or some neighborhood friend will testify to this in court. Who will say that on the night of the murder, Sahil was in Delhi, not Meerut. His phone's location may also be shown as Delhi. The accused has the right to present their side Government lawyer Rekha Jain, who is handling the Sahil-muskaan case, is not ready to say anything about this entire case. She says that she has strict orders and cannot speak about this matter. The entire case is going through the judicial process, is under the court's jurisdiction, and the hearing is taking place in the court. She said that every accused has the right to present their case, to prove their innocence in their favor. Sahil-muskaan also have this right, so they can absolutely present their side. This right cannot be taken away from the accused. Sahil saw muskaan's daughter Radha for the first time Sahil-muskaan came to court together on April 21, 2026, after March 18, 2025. 13 months ago, both were presented in this same court and sent to jail. Since then, both had been appearing online. On April 21, both stayed together for about one and a half hours. First, both were made to sit in the police van. Where Sahil saw the face of muskaan's daughter Radha for the first time. After this, both were presented in court. Both stayed there together for 46 minutes. However, both could not talk to each other in the courtroom. The murder case came to light on March 17, 2025 In Meerut's Brahmpuri area, on March 3, Saurabh was murdered by his wife muskaan along with her lover Sahil Rajput. After this, the body was cut into 3 pieces, put in a drum, and sealed with a mixture of cement and sand. The case was uncovered on March 17. On March 18, muskaan and Sahil were sent to jail. Testimony of 22 witnesses completed In the Merchant Navy Officer Saurabh murder case, statements of 22 witnesses have been recorded so far. After these testimonies, the prosecution's evidence has been closed. Now the process under Section 313 will begin in court. After this, final arguments will take place and then the court will pronounce its verdict. Know the complete case muskaan-Sahil stayed in the lobby all night with the body

stories.title: 'My son is not a professional criminal, he was misled':Mother of man who abused women in Bareilly, impersonated police officer pleads for him to be forgiven
stories.summary: 'My son has not committed such a big mistake that he should be considered a criminal. He should be forgiven for a small error. He is not a professional criminal, he must have been misled. Now he has received punishment for his mistake. Therefore, he should be released.' This is the statement of the mother of Hasan Khan, who called women dancing at a wedding procession in Bareilly, 'witches'. On Monday, April 20, Hasan Khan had uploaded a video on his Instagram account. In it, he was sitting in a car. Women were dancing on the road. Hasan says, 'Look at this, they are dancing as if witches are dancing. Damn it, they have made life hell.' People had objected to this. After this, the police arrested Hasan within 12 hours. Hasan kept crying and pleading before the police and kept apologizing. However, the police sent him to jail. Bhaskar reached Hasan Khan's house. There was silence there. Hasan's mother Sahana is in a bad state from crying. Read the full report... Hasan is a driver, father does labor work Hasan Khan's house is in Kanjadaspura, Bareilly. Hasan is a driver by profession. At home live his father Gulfam, mother Sahana and younger brother Faizan. The younger brother is studying in 12th grade. Father Gulfam does labor work. Mother Sahana is a housewife. Hasan was working for a YouTube channel some time ago. Due to this, he became acquainted with some policemen. Taking advantage of this influence, he also bought a police jacket. He would often wear the police uniform and make reels with policemen and post them on Instagram. So that he could show off to people. Mother said, 'Family runs on daily wages, how will household expenses be managed' Mother Sahana said- Our family is living in extreme poverty. There was nothing so serious in the video for which my son was sent to jail. Sahana said with a choked voice- My son is not a criminal. He is still a child. He just made a small mistake, which has been made into such a big issue. Humans are the ones who make mistakes. He has already received punishment for his mistake. When the police arrested and took him away, no one came to see what condition we were in. We are poor people, we earn our living through labor. I fold my hands and plead that he be forgiven. Mother Sahana, referring to the video, said - If you people carefully watch that video yourself, there is nothing major in it. He just got carried away in the pursuit of making a reel. Hasan's father and brother work hard day and night. We have no enmity with anyone. We just want that he not be punished anymore and be allowed to return home. Mother said, 'Wearing police jacket was his childish act' On this, we asked Sahana questions about Hassan's police uniform reel and YouTube. Sahana said- My son used to work for a YouTube channel earlier. Perhaps he made some acquaintances there. He never wished ill for anyone. Nor did he force anyone. He just minded his own business. Wearing the police jacket was his childish act. Which he did out of hobby. Brother Faizan said, 'Hasan has accepted his mistake' Hasan's younger brother Faizan said - My family is very ordinary. Whatever my brother did was wrong. We accept that. But now he has accepted his mistake. We want him to be given a chance so that he can reform. He is the eldest son of the house. He helps run the household by driving. Without him, the condition of the house will become even worse. What did Hasan say in the video? In the video that Hasan Khan uploaded, he was going somewhere in a car. During this time, a wedding procession was passing on his way. Women were dancing on the road to DJ and band music. On this, Hasan said - Look, there is no shortage in Bareilly. What can I say, sometimes we get stuck in such places, it becomes difficult to get out. 'The Damn Women Make Life Hell' After going a little further, some police personnel were seen standing at the intersection. At this, he said - These are our Daroga ji standing. After this, he said to the police personnel - Sir, I am going. Then he says that I work duty with them. Today was a long tour. They dance like witches. The damn women make our life hell. Police Arrested Hasan Within 12 Hours After the matter came to light on April 20, Hindu organizations had protested. After this, the police registered an FIR based on the video and arrested Hasan within about 12 hours. In the arrest video, Hasan apologized with folded hands in front of the police. Confessing his crime, he told that he had bought a police jacket from a shop near Chaupla. In a show-off, he wore it and posted a photo.

stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh is facing an intense heatwave. On Thursday, a heatwave alert has been issued for 32 districts. Strong sunshine has been prevailing since morning, along with humid conditions. Strong winds are also being recorded. The Meteorological Department (IMD) has said that there is no relief expected from the heat for the next three days, till 25 April, and temperatures may cross 45°C. Weather change likely after 26 April However, from 26 April, the weather is expected to change again. A spell of rain with thunderstorms will begin from western Uttar Pradesh and gradually cover the entire state. Rain with thunder and lightning is expected across UP till 28 April, bringing some relief from the heat. But from 29 April onwards, the heat is likely to return with full intensity. In the last 24 hours, temperatures in 30 districts of the state recorded 40°C or more. Banda was the hottest, recording a maximum temperature of 44.2°C. Apart from Bijnor, all districts recorded minimum temperatures above 20°C. Arrangements in zoos and temples In Lucknow Zoo, arrangements have been made for animals including ice slabs, clean water and coolers. Around 48 sprinklers have been installed to keep enclosures cool. Gorillas are being given watermelon. In the mini zoo at Sarnath, Varanasi, deer and barasingha are being fed muskmelon, cucumber and gourd. The diet of birds has also been changed. Meteorologist Atul Singh in Lucknow said that due to an anti-cyclone system near Maharashtra, temperatures may rise by 2–3°C in the next 2–3 days. The entire state will remain under heatwave conditions. From 26 April, a new spell of rain will begin from western UP and continue for three days, bringing some relief. 3 pictures of the weather Know the condition of cities- Water stream arranged for Baba Vishwanath In view of extreme heat, special arrangements have been made in temples of Ayodhya, Kashi and Mathura. In Kashi, a water stream has been installed for Baba Vishwanath. Red carpets and German hangers have been set up for devotees. In the Braj region, major temples including Banke Bihari and Dwarkadhish are being decorated with flower arrangements. Cold offerings like muskmelon and sattu are being offered to deities. At Priyakant Ju temple, arrangements for boat rides have been made for the deity. In Ayodhya, three coolers have been installed in the sanctum for Ram Lalla. stories.title: Mirzapur road accident kills 11:Bolero catches fire after collision, 9 victims burnt alive; PM announces ₹2 lakh compensation for kin of deceased
stories.summary: A major road accident in Uttar Pradesh’s Mirzapur district on Wednesday night claimed the lives of 11 people. A trailer carrying gravel from Madhya Pradesh went out of control after its brakes failed. The trailer first hit a Swift car and then collided with a truck. The car got trapped between the trailer and the truck. Meanwhile, a Bolero coming from behind crashed into the trailer. The Bolero then caught fire after a loud explosion. Nine people, including the driver, were burnt alive. All the deceased were related to each other. Apart from this, the driver of the Swift car and the cleaner of the truck also died. The accident took place in the Dhramdaganj police station area. SP Aparna Rajat Kaushik said that all the people in the Bolero were residents of Naraina village under Jigna police station. The family was returning after performing a child’s tonsure (mundan) ceremony in Maihar. An 8-year-old child and his mother were among those killed in the accident. A critically injured truck cleaner was admitted to hospital, where he later died during treatment. Police and fire brigade teams reached the spot immediately after receiving information and carried out rescue operations. Sequence of the Incident At around 9:30 pm on the Mirzapur–Rewa National Highway, a trailer loaded with gravel was moving from Barka Mod when its brakes suddenly failed. A Bolero was also descending a slope behind the trailer at that time. The uncontrolled trailer first crushed a Swift car and then collided with a truck. The Bolero coming from behind then rammed into the trailer. According to eyewitnesses, the impact was so severe that the Bolero immediately caught fire. All passengers inside were trapped and burnt alive. The incident led to chaos and screams at the spot. Local people rushed to help, but the intense fire made rescue impossible. PM Modi announces compensation for kin of deceased victims Prime Minister Narendra Modi posted on X saying, an ex-gratia of Rs 2 lakh would be given to the next of kin of those killed in the accident. Meanwhile, the injured would receive Rs 50,000. Mirzapur MP Anupriya Patel expressed grief over the accident. Police and administration response On receiving information, SP Aparna Rajat Kaushik, CO Lalganj Amar Bahadur, and police teams from Lalganj and Hallia reached the site. Fire brigade teams later brought the fire under control. Mirzapur MP Anupriya Patel expressed grief over the incident. Victims identified According to the District Magistrate of Mirzapur, the family of Arun Singh from Naraina village under Jigna police station had gone to Maihar for his son Shiva’s (7) mundan ceremony. Shiva and his mother Vandana Singh (38) also died in the accident. Other deceased from the same family include Veena Singh (47), Piyush Singh (15), and daughter Sonam. In addition, Priyanka (42), Kartikeya (18), Pankaj Singh (40), Sonam (9), and Vishnu (Bolero driver, resident of Rampur) died after being burnt alive in the Bolero. Priyanka Singh and Kartikeya Singh were from Madhya Pradesh and had come to attend the ceremony. Swift car driver Jay Prakash (27) from Sonbhadra also died, along with truck cleaner Vikas, who was a resident of Madhya Pradesh and later succumbed to his injuries.

stories.title: Fighter jets roar on Purvanchal Expressway:6-hour drill of Jaguar, Sukhoi, Mirage leaves spectators amazed
stories.summary: On April 22, the Purvanchal Expressway looked no less than a battlefield. On the nearly 3-km-long emergency airstrip built in Sultanpur, the Indian Air Force displayed its powerful capabilities in a striking air show. The air show began around 2 PM. After that, fighter jets including Jaguar, Sukhoi, and Mirage roared across the sky one after another. They carried out precision drills including touch-and-go manoeuvres as well as accurate take-offs and landings. Commandos drop from Mi-17 Helicopter in high-intensity drill The most thrilling moment of the air show came when commandos landed on the expressway from an Mi-17 helicopter and executed a mock operation. During this exercise, a stretch of about 5 km was completely sealed off for security purposes. Thousands of people gathered to witness the powerful display of the Indian Air Force’s capabilities.

stories.title: UP voters deliver strong political message through Bhaskar survey:Reject 354 of 400 MLAs ahead of 2027 polls
stories.summary: A major Dainik Bhaskar survey on MLAs in Uttar Pradesh has delivered striking results. Out of 400 MLAs, 354, or 88.5%, do not want the same candidates to be re-nominated in the 2027 elections. Party-wise data shows that out of 257 BJP MLAs, 226 (88%) are not preferred for re-nomination. Among 105 Samajwadi Party (SP) MLAs, 96 (91%) face public dissatisfaction. Out of 33 MLAs from BJP allies, 30 are also not favoured by voters. Only 39 MLAs are considered suitable for re-ticketing. However, there is no clear opinion on 7 MLAs, including Uttar Pradesh Finance Minister Suresh Khanna from Shahjahanpur. Among strongmen, only Raja Bhaiya is liked In terms of strongman leaders, only Raghuraj Pratap Singh, popularly known as Raja Bhaiya from Kunda (Jan Satta Dal Loktantrik), continues to enjoy public approval for re-nomination. On the other hand, voters have expressed dissatisfaction with several influential leaders, including SP rebel MLA Abhay Singh from Gosainganj (Ayodhya), Sujeet Singh from Sayed Raja (Chandauli), Madan Bhaiya from the RLD in western UP, Ramakant Yadav from Phoolpur Pawai in Azamgarh, and Prabhu Narayan Singh Yadav from Sakaldiha in Chandauli 31 Muslim MLAs, work of 29 not liked Uttar Pradesh has a total of 31 Muslim MLAs across parties. Of these, 29 (93.54%) have been rejected by voters for their performance. The majority of these are from the Samajwadi Party, with 25 MLAs accounting for 80% of the total Muslim MLAs. One MLA each from RLD, Apna Dal (S), and SBSP has also been rejected by the public. Only two Muslim MLAs have received approval from voters: Naseem Solanki from Sisamau (Kanpur) and Kamal Akhtar from Kanth (Moradabad). More Discontent with MLAs in Purvanchal, Bundelkhand The survey shows the highest dissatisfaction in Purvanchal and Bundelkhand. Most people could not form an opinion about 4 MLAs from Awadh In the survey, people could not form a clear opinion about 7 MLAs. That is, they were not in a position to say whether they should be given tickets again or not. The maximum number of MLAs about whom there is no clear opinion are 4 from the Awadh region. These include 3 MLAs from BJP and 1 from SP. People could also not form an opinion about 3 MLAs from Purvanchal, Braj and Western UP. All three seats have NDA MLAs. SP's women MLAs more preferred compared to BJP Uttar Pradesh has 51 women MLAs. Among them, 30 are from BJP, 15 from SP, 4 from Apna Dal (S), and 1 each from RLD and Congress. The survey shows that 46 women MLAs (90%) are not preferred for re-ticketing. Only 5 women MLAs are considered suitable for re-nomination, including 3 from SP (20%) and 1 from BJP (4%). There are 349 male MLAs in the Assembly. Out of these, 308 (88%) have been rejected by voters. Party-wise, 93.33% of SP MLAs, 87.22% of BJP MLAs, and 90% of MLAs from allied parties have failed to meet public expectations. Even 123 first-time MLAs did not perform well Among 137 first-time MLAs, 123 (89.78%) have been rejected by voters. This includes MLAs from BJP (65), SP (36), Apna Dal (S) (10), Nishad Party (5), RLD (3), SBSP (3), and Congress (1). However, 9 BJP MLAs and 5 SP MLAs among first-timers have received public approval for re-ticketing.

stories.title: UP Vishwakarma girl’s death sparks politics:Rahul-Priyanka question safety of daughters; Akhilesh shows father’s video
stories.summary: Politics has started over the death of a 16-year-old girl in Ghazipur. Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha, Rahul Gandhi, and his MP sister, Priyanka Gandhi, on Saturday targeted the central and state governments. They alleged that the girl was raped and murdered. Meanwhile, SP chief Akhilesh Yadav has announced his visit to Ghazipur on April 29. Akhilesh told the media at the party headquarters on Saturday, “If the family refuses, we will not go to meet them, but the family is not refusing.” Akhilesh also showed a video. The SP chief alleged that the police and BJP are pressuring the victim's father for a compromise. Ghazipur Police has responded to Rahul and Priyanka. It said, the deceased's father had called Dial 112 and informed that the girl had committed suicide by jumping from the bridge. There is no mention of rape even in the FIR registered on the father's complaint in the matter. No rape-related facts have emerged in the post-mortem either. Please do not spread any unverified, baseless, and false rumors that disturb peace in society. Police have arrested one accused of murder and 10 accused of stone-pelting in the case. More arrests are ongoing. What the leaders said, Rahul demanded answers from PM Modi and CM Yogi Rahul Gandhi wrote on X, "Rape and brutal murder of a daughter from the Vishwakarma community in Ghazipur - and then threats and violence to prevent the family from filing an FIR. Hathras, Kathua, Unnao and today Ghazipur - this is a pattern. The daughter of Manipur died waiting for justice. Every time the same face - the victim is Dalit, backward, tribal, poor. Every time the same truth - protection for the perpetrator, torture for the victim. Every time the same silence - from the powerful, who should have spoken. The government of a country and state where parents have to beg to get an FIR registered for their daughter has no moral right to remain in power. Action should be taken against the guilty police officers. The family should get protection. A high-level investigation should be conducted and justice should be delivered immediately. Modi ji, Chief Minister ji, answer. Why are daughters so unsafe in your rule? In such situations, justice is not asked for, it is snatched. And we will snatch it." Priyanka Gandhi said - Prime Minister's big talks are a show-off Congress MP Priyanka Gandhi alleged that in cases of crimes against women in the state, the victim is always harassed. She said that delaying FIR registration, threatening families, and influential people spoiling the atmosphere further worsen the situation of women in the state. Under BJP rule, this has now become the undeclared law that whenever a woman is subjected to atrocities, the victim herself is further tormented. The Prime Minister's grand statements about women are just a show. Be it Unnao, Hathras, Prayagraj, or Ghazipur, wherever injustice was done to women, the BJP, with its full power, stood against the victim and with the oppressor. Akhilesh said - BJP's gaze is like a vulture's On the Ghazipur incident, Akhilesh said - If the family refuses, we will not go to meet them, but the family is not refusing. You haven't seen the video. What is the father saying in it? The police are also sitting there. Akhilesh played a video. In it, an elderly man (the girl's father) is saying that his daughter has died. There will be a decision on that, won't there? Why were you giving us money? CO sir, we are not people of money. We are in sorrow right now. Otherwise, we would have dragged the Pandit from his house. We are blacksmiths. Why were you giving money? Meanwhile, a person says that if you speak like this, how will we find a solution? Please sit peacefully. We are more saddened than you are. In 6 hours, the matter will go directly to the Chief Minister's office. So please give us some time. To this, the elderly person says that the accused was kept in jail for 4 days. How many shoes did they hit him with? Why didn't they ask where the daughter was kept? To this, the CO says that they had asked in front of him. To this, the elderly person says that you only slapped him once. Now you are lying that you hit him four times with shoes. Akhilesh said, the question is not about castes. The question is that you are unable to deliver justice. If he is complaining, then see how the police behaved. Who is giving the caste angle? It is BJP. We are with the poor. There are three homes of the Vishwakarma community in that village. When the police behaved with Shankaracharya ji. SP stood with him. It's not our, but BJP's vulture eye. When people lose their lives, BJP people feel happy. Getting investigations done, falsely implicating people is their nature. BJP people can even implicate his father.

stories.title: Groom collapses unconscious on wedding stage in Hapur:Bride cries saying, 'He was intoxicated, my life is ruined'
stories.summary: In Hapur on Saturday night, the groom suddenly fell ill on the garland exchange stage. He fainted and collapsed unconscious. Seeing this, chaos ensued. The bride started crying profusely. The wedding had to be stopped. Seeing the groom's condition, his family members panicked. In a hurry, the relatives took the groom to a private hospital located on Garh Road. Doctors said that the groom's blood pressure had increased. This caused the situation. The groom's condition is being reported as out of danger. The bride Anjali kept crying continuously. The women of the house consoled her. The bride said, 'My life is ruined. He was intoxicated on the garland exchange stage. There was a smell coming from his mouth.' The girl refused to marry. There was also an argument between the groom's and bride's sides. Finally, the wedding procession returned. The matter is from Kotwali Nagar area. Now know the entire incident in sequence The wedding procession came from Ghaziabad The wedding procession of Mintu, son of Mahendra Singh, a resident of Vijay Nagar in Ghaziabad, arrived in Hapur on Saturday night. There was dancing and singing to DJ music in the procession and the atmosphere was cheerful. The groom was also dancing with his friends and family members. After the door worship ceremony, the garland exchange ritual began. Groom Mintu reached the stage. The bride had also arrived. Just then, Mintu suddenly started feeling dizzy. He collapsed on the stage. Seeing this, there was panic among the bride's side and the wedding guests. Family members immediately admitted the groom to a nearby hospital. The groom's friend Lalit Sharma said that Mintu is fine now, but due to this incident the wedding rituals could not be completed and the program had to be stopped. After the incident, the atmosphere deteriorated. The bride's side expressed their displeasure by stopping the wedding procession and refused the marriage. It is alleged that the groom's side was misbehaved with and there was an argument between both sides, which escalated the dispute. During this, someone gave false information to the police about firing at the wedding ceremony. Chaos situation at marriage hall for one and a half hours Police reached the spot as soon as they received the information, but upon investigation, the firing incident turned out to be completely false. A chaotic situation prevailed at the marriage hall for about one to one and a half hours. Police intervened and brought both parties to the police station to calm the situation. The bride's side accused the groom of being intoxicated with alcohol, while the groom's side denied it. Along with this, a dispute has also come to light regarding the demand for a Scorpio car as dowry. The bride's brother-in-law says that the groom was intoxicated. He was taken to the hospital. Where it was confirmed that he was intoxicated. He said that the girl's life has been ruined. Earlier, the boy's side had demanded a big car. But after persuasion, it was agreed to give a small car. The groom had a seizure on stage Bride Anjali said - My life has been ruined, as soon as I went on stage, he had a seizure. His teeth were clenched. He was grinding his teeth. Anjali said that the groom's family had demanded a car. Which her father somehow gave by taking a loan. On stage he was intoxicated. There was a smell coming from his mouth. In this matter, an attempt was made to know the groom's side, but no one came forward. Station In-charge Vinod Pandey said- Police had received information about firing, but nothing of that sort was found upon reaching the spot. Due to the groom's deteriorating health during the garland ceremony, a rumor spread in the confusion, whereas no incident like firing occurred at the spot. The entire matter is being investigated and further action will be taken based on facts.

stories.title: Mother rushes to killer's house to avenge Bulandshahr triple murder:Sister says, 'Set their houses on fire'; heavy police forces deployed
stories.summary: The case of the murder of two brothers and a nephew of a BJP leader in Bulandshahr is in the headlines. When Manish was shot at a birthday party on Saturday night, his mother had gone to Ayodhya for darshan. Upon returning, when she learned about the incident, she ran towards the accused's house to take revenge. After much effort, family members calmed her down. After this, she fainted while crying and wailing. Meanwhile, sister Rajni said, 'Come with me, set fire to their houses. Brother was called on the pretext of a feast and then he was killed without reason. I want revenge for my brother's blood. The demand from CM Yogi is that strict action should be taken against the culprits.' What did the family members say about the incident, read the report... The case at a glance In Bulandshahr, during a birthday party on Saturday night at 12 o'clock, the brother, cousin and nephew of a BJP leader were murdered. A party was going on in the gym. Eyewitnesses said that the BJP leader's cousin smeared cake on the face of the accused birthday boy. This enraged him. First there was an argument. After this, the accused along with his companions opened indiscriminate fire on the BJP leader's brothers and nephew. Manish Saini (30), Aakash Saini (19) and Amardeep Saini (32) lost their lives in the firing. Manish was the younger brother of BJP councillor Sanjay Saini of Ward No. 24, while Aakash was his nephew and Amardeep was his cousin's son. What the family has to say Simran, wife of the deceased Amardeep, said - He had left home saying he was going to some party or cake function. He said he would be back soon. Someone called his nephew, who also said the same thing that he would be back soon. Both did not return. Everything happened according to a plan. CCTV cameras had already been removed from there. The police are not taking any action. My husband had no old enmity. Everyone was friends. They lived together well. I want justice. Sister said, ‘We have lost two, they should also lose two’ Amardeep's sister Radha said - Bulldozers should be run on the accused's houses and factories. Blood for blood is needed. Two dead bodies have been taken from our house. My brother and my nephew have been killed. Sister-in-law called me, then I came to know about this tragedy. Police is not doing anything. The monsters are sitting comfortably. Just as I have lost two, they should also lose theirs. There was a heated argument between the police and the relatives of the deceased. They had a heated debate with Station House Officer Inspector Premchandra. The relatives said that now we want blood for blood. Three of ours have died, so three from their side should also die. Force from 10 police stations deployed at accused's house Considering the seriousness of the situation, apart from police force from 10 stations, 2 companies of PAC have been deployed at the accused's house. The deceased and the accused are residents of the same locality. Their houses are also nearby. Now understand the entire incident in sequence FIR registered against 10, 4 in custody According to police, accused Jeetu and Mayank Saini are the main accused in the case. Jeetu fired with Mayank's pistol. After the incident, the accused fled with the CCTV DVR. Police have registered an FIR against 10 people including Jeetu-Mayank. 4 have been taken into custody and are being interrogated. Search for the rest is ongoing. ADG says, ‘Three people have been arrested, 8 teams engaged in investigation’ The ADG informed that on the night of 25-26, information was received at Kotwali Khurja Nagar in Bulandshahr that Amardeep, Aakash and Manish, all three were present in the gym where a birthday program was going on. During this, a dispute arose over something, which escalated. Three people have been arrested in the case so far. Eight teams are working on this case. The entire situation will be clarified by this evening. The preliminary investigation suggests that the bullet was fired from a .32 bore revolver, however, this can only be confirmed after the postmortem report arrives. Orders given to form SIT On government instructions, ADG Meerut Zone Bhanu Bhaskar has ordered the formation of an SIT to investigate the case. Following this, DIG Kalanidhi Naithani has assigned the investigation responsibility to IPS Antariksh Jain. A report has been demanded within 48 hours regarding the functioning of Kotwali police. It is believed that action against Kotwali police is certain in this matter.
