stories.title: Yogi Adityanath says no iftar on streets in UP:Alleges TMC opposed CAA to curb Hindu population growth
stories.summary: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath held an election rally in Nadia district of West Bengal on Saturday. During campaigning for the Nabadwip assembly seat, he said, “TMC had opposed the CAA. This law will grant Indian citizenship to Hindus, Buddhists, and Jains who came distressed from Pakistan and Bangladesh.” “But, Mamata Didi feels bad that if there are more Hindus, how will iftar parties happen on the streets. In UP, no one can hold iftar parties on the streets, cannot offer namaz, and no sound comes from mosques,” he added. Read the key points from CM Yogi's speech 1. Had to approach High Court for Durga Puja CM Yogi said, "At the time of Bengal partition, Vande Mataram had become a weapon for every Bengali, but Mamata Didi is irritated by all this. She has a problem with people saying Jai Shri Ram in Bengal. The Kolkata High Court had to order that those who are creating disorder during Durga Puja should be stopped. This government, which has become a symbol of mafia raj in Bengal, is not ready to listen to anything. You must have seen the day before yesterday how TMC goons were attacking BJP workers. On May 4th, when the results come, these goons will have no place to hide. 2. 'There is no curfew in UP, no riots, everything is fine in UP' CM Yogi said - Once Bengal had the highest contribution to India's economy. Daughters and sisters used to be safe, but now goonda tax is being collected. Cattle mafia, sand mafia, land mafia are increasing. The money that Modi ji sends from Delhi, TMC goons use that money to support their families. Until 2017, the situation in UP was the same. Traders were migrating, incidents of love jihad and land jihad were increasing, lathis and bullets were fired for saying Jai Shri Ram. Today there is a double engine government in UP. Today there is no curfew in UP, no riots, everything is fine in UP. 3. Bengal faces an identity crisis CM Yogi said - The Bengal which gave India its identity, today faces an identity crisis. The TMC government has become a symbol of mafia raj, terror and corruption in 15 years. Its goons are roaming openly. The CM said that two days ago, in the first phase of voting, people cast their votes in record numbers. From what is being heard now, from what scenes are visible, when the results come on May 4, saffron flags will be seen waving everywhere. 4. 'UP's bulldozer buries the mafia in the dust' CM Yogi said - A grand temple has been built at Lord Ram's birthplace in Ayodhya. Congress, Communists and TMC could not stop it. Ropeways are being built in UP now, expressways are being built. Every person has a guarantee of security. The CM said - UP's bulldozer doesn't just build expressways, it also buries the mafia's bones and ribs in the dust. Mamata Didi says 'Khela Hobe' (the game will happen), we say that now Bengal has awakened. Now the game is over, progress has begun. Now a double engine government will work in Bengal.

Despite the scorching heat, candidates showed up in large numbers, many covering their heads with towels to cope with the conditions. Authorities have set up around 55 examination centres in the city for nearly 1.33 lakh candidates. See pictures The examination is scheduled over three days—April 25, 26, and 27—and will be conducted in two shifts daily: 10 AM to 12 PM and 3 PM to 5 PM. Approximately 22,000 candidates are expected to appear in each shift.

stories.title: Lover strangles woman to death in Lucknow:Absconds on the pretext of brining medicine leaving daughter behind
stories.summary: In Lucknow, a woman was allegedly killed by her lover, who strangled her and fled the scene after leaving the body at the house. Police reached the spot on information and sent the body for post-mortem. The incident took place late Friday night near Lala Bagh on Ring Road under Thakurganj police station area. The deceased has been identified as Neelam Saxena (42). The woman was living in a temporary hut built on an empty plot along with her lover and her 8-year-old daughter. Her body was found in the same plot on Saturday morning. Marriage took place 15 years ago According to the victim’s brother Naresh, Neelam was married 15 years ago to Sanjay Saxena, a resident of Gaur Atrauli in Hardoi. The couple had four daughters — Shivani, Pranshi, Madhu and Nidhi. Earlier, the family lived in a rented house in Balaganj. About four months ago, Neelam separated from her husband. She then started living with Sanjay Gautam from Kaundiya, Atrauli, Hardoi, along with her youngest daughter Nidhi. The couple was living in a hut on an empty plot near Noble Hospital in Lala Bagh, Ring Road area of Thakurganj. The three elder daughters were staying at their maternal home. Strangled while sleeping The victim’s daughter Nidhi said that on Friday night, after having dinner, her mother went to sleep. During the night, Sanjay Gautam allegedly strangled her. He reportedly told the girl that he was going to bring medicine and left the house. He did not return. The child fell asleep and later found her mother dead in the morning. No injury marks found on the body Police said that information about the death was given at 3:30 am on Saturday by Naresh, a resident of Hiyatganj, Atrauli, Hardoi. Police reached the spot and carried out an investigation. No visible injury marks were found on the body. A forensic team collected evidence from the scene. Officials said there is no clear evidence of murder at this stage. It has also come to light that the deceased was reportedly addicted to alcohol. All angles are being investigated, and the exact cause of death will be confirmed after the post-mortem report, which will decide further legal action.

stories.title: UP Home Guard recruitment exam begins at 1053 centres:25 lakh candidates appear for 42,000 posts amid strict biometric checks
stories.summary: The examination for recruitment to 42,000 Home Guard posts in Uttar Pradesh began on Saturday morning at 10 am with the first shift. Entry was allowed only after strict checking at examination centres. Candidates were subjected to retina scanning and biometric verification before entering the centres. In Jaunpur, candidates were made to remove their shoes. In Sambhal, religious threads (kalawa) were cut. Shoes, belts, bangles and amulets were also removed during the checking process. The examination has started at 1053 centres across the state and will continue for three days till 27 April. Around 25 lakh candidates are expected to appear. The state police has been placed on high alert for the duration of the exam. The exam will carry 100 marks and will include multiple-choice questions. The duration of the examination is 2 hours. UP Police Recruitment Board Chairman SB Shiradkar said that examination centres have been set up in all districts except Shravasti. See pictures... Board had earlier issued instructions During earlier recruitment exams, incidents of removal of religious symbols like kalawa and mangalsutra had led to controversy. The UP Police Recruitment and Promotion Board had then issued clear instructions that religious and cultural symbols such as kalawa and mangalsutra should not be removed. It had warned that disciplinary action would be taken against those found violating these instructions to prevent such incidents in future.

stories.title: Pregnant girlfriend killed in Prayagraj:Boyfriend Monish Patel admits to slamming down, strangling her after argument over marriage
stories.summary: “I have been in a physical relationship with you for one and a half years. I have become pregnant. The child in my womb is yours. Now you are going to marry another girl. You keep lying repeatedly. You used to say you will convince your family, otherwise we will run away and get married. Either marry me, or let us run away together. I will die, but I will not leave you.” This warning was given by a girl from Prayagraj to her lover Monish Patel, who later killed her. Monish has disclosed all details to the police. ACP Phulpur Vivek Yadav said that on 23 April, the body of a 20-year-old girl was found a short distance from her home. There were injury marks on her neck and face. In this case, Monish and two others have been arrested. How love turned into murder ACP said that 24-year-old Monish Patel and the girl had been in a relationship for two years. Their houses were just 20 metres apart. After studying till Class 8, the girl had stopped going to school. Their affair was known in the village, and even Monish’s family was not in favour of the relationship. Meanwhile, Monish kept promising marriage. About one and a half years ago, the relationship became physical. He would often call her to meet. At night, they used to meet in fields or empty plots away from the village. When they could not meet, they stayed in touch through phone calls and chats. Beaten by family three months ago Police interrogation revealed that three months ago, Monish called the girl to meet at night. Her family got to know about this and the next day, relatives and family members beat Monish badly. Even then, Monish’s family clearly said they would not allow marriage with the girl. Despite this, their contact continued. Meanwhile, Monish’s marriage was fixed elsewhere by his family. The wedding was scheduled in June. However, Monish hid this from the girl and continued promising marriage. Their meetings continued. Threat led to murder During police interrogation, Monish said he was shocked when the girl told him she was pregnant. The girl started insisting that he marry her. Monish no longer wanted to marry her and tried to distance himself, but the situation worsened. The girl threatened that she would go to the police station and reveal everything. This frightened Monish. On the night of 22 April, Monish called her to meet. He tried to convince her, and when she did not agree, he threatened her. Even then, the girl refused to accept anything. She said she would go to the police and also inform the family where his marriage was fixed. After this, Monish pushed her down, sat on her, and strangled her to death. Postmortem confirmed that the girl was two months pregnant. Two brothers abroad, 4 tractors at home ACP Phulpur Vivek Yadav said Monish comes from a wealthy farming family. His father is a big farmer and the family owns four tractors, which Monish operates. His two brothers work in Saudi Arabia. The family earns well from agriculture. In contrast, the girl’s family is poor. Her father works on others’ farmland, and her brother also does share-cropping. Father and brother also made accused ACP said Monish’s father, 65-year-old Lal Bahadur Patel, and elder brother Vikas Patel have also been made accused in the murder case. They have been booked for conspiracy. Police said both knew about the relationship. They were aware that Monish used to meet the girl. They also knew about the murder but misled the police instead of informing them. Body found near the house The body was found on 23 April morning in Sandalpur Malehtua village of Prayagraj, about 10 metres from her house. There were deep injury marks on her face and head. Family said that on the night of 22 April, she had dinner with everyone and then went to sleep in her room. In the morning, when her younger brother went to wake her to feed the cow, she was not in the room. Later, her body was found about 10 metres away from the house.

stories.title: Youtuber Salim Vastik arrested after 25 years:Convicted in 1995 child kidnapping and killing of businessman’s 13-year-old son
stories.summary: Ghaziabad’s former ex-Muslim YouTuber Salim Vastik, who himself was earlier attacked and had his throat slit, has now been found to be a convicted murderer in a shocking revelation. Delhi Police arrested him on Saturday. He had been absconding for the past 25 years. Ghaziabad Police Commissioner J. Ravindra Gaur said that Delhi Police reached Salim’s residence on Saturday morning and took him away after questioning. According to Delhi Police officials, on 20 January 1995, Salim kidnapped 13-year-old Sandeep Bansal, son of a businessman in Delhi. After ransom demands were not met by the family, the boy was killed. Officials said Salim was arrested after the incident and sent to jail. In 1997, he was sentenced to life imprisonment. However, in 2000 he was granted bail, after which he went missing. Since then, he had been living under different identities across Shamli, Muzaffarnagar, Meerut, and Ghaziabad. The YouTuber who left Islam was stabbed 14 times Background of the murder case Delhi Police stated that Salim had kidnapped the 13-year-old son of a businessman on 20 January 1995. After ransom was not paid, the child was murdered. He was arrested and later sentenced to life imprisonment in 1997. He was released on bail in 2000 and then absconded. For the past 25 years, he had been changing identities and living in different cities of western Uttar Pradesh.

stories.title: Samajwadi Party shifts caste strategy for 2027 polls:Focus moves from Purvanchal to Western UP challenge
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party is giving a new direction to its caste-based electoral strategy for the 2027 Assembly elections. The party has appointed Rajbhar community leader Seema Rajbhar as the National President of the Women’s Wing and Rukmani Devi Nishad, sister of Phoolan Devi, as the State President of the Women’s Wing, in an attempt to strengthen its hold in Purvanchal. Now, the SP’s focus has shifted to Western Uttar Pradesh. This region has always been the party’s weak link. In the 2022 Assembly elections, SP failed to win even a single seat in 12 districts of this region, despite being in alliance with the Rashtriya Lok Dal (RLD). Even the Yadav-Muslim equation has not delivered significant results here. What is the reason behind this? Read the full report. Why SP remains weak in Western UP Senior journalist Rajendra Kumar explains that Western UP has around 15% Jat and 20% Dalit population. The BJP-RLD alliance has a strong hold over Jats, while BSP and Chandrashekhar’s influence is strong among Jatav-Dalits. Another major factor is the 2013 Muzaffarnagar riots, which created a deep divide between Jats, Gurjars, Jatavs, and Muslims. The Muslim-Yadav (M-Y) equation also does not have a major impact here. The Jat-Gurjar-Dalit combination largely remains in favour of the BJP. This time, under its PDA formula, SP is trying to bring together Gurjars, Muslims, and non-Jatav Dalits to make inroads into the Jat-Jatav vote base, especially in constituencies where BJP is strong. This is why SP is searching for leaders from Jat and Dalit communities who can increase its vote share. SP failed to open account in 12 districts of Western UP in 2022 Senior journalist Rajendra Kumar further explains that Jats and Jatav communities have traditionally stayed away from SP in Western UP. In the 2022 Assembly elections, due to the SP-RLD alliance, some Jats supported SP. Out of 136 seats in Western UP, SP won 35 and RLD won 8. Without any alliance, BJP managed to win 93 seats, which is about 69% of the total. In 12 districts including Bulandshahr, Hapur, Agra, Mathura, and Etah, SP could not win a single seat. In the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, when RLD aligned with BJP, the BJP’s position became even stronger. Out of 27 Lok Sabha seats in Western UP, BJP-RLD won 15, while SP managed 10. Similarly, Jatav Dalits have never been aligned with SP. This vote bank has traditionally been dominated by Mayawati. With BSP weakening and Chandrashekhar’s Azad Samaj Party gaining strength, this vote shifted further. A section of non-Jatav Dalits also moved towards BJP. In the Lok Sabha elections, SP fielded Dalit candidates in seats like Ayodhya and Meerut. While SP won in Ayodhya, it narrowly lost Meerut by around 10,000 votes. Now, SP may attempt a similar experiment in the upcoming Assembly elections. However, Mayawati is regaining strength, and all parties are targeting Dalit votes. Therefore, SP is searching for influential Jatav leaders with strong presence across Western UP, or at least leaders with influence in individual districts. Eastern UP gives SP a 26-seat advantage Compared to Western UP, SP’s position in Eastern UP appears stronger. Out of 102 Assembly seats in the region, SP had won 31 seats. At that time, Om Prakash Rajbhar’s SBSP was also with Akhilesh Yadav, and the party had won 6 seats. Although BJP had won 53 seats, it failed to open its account in districts like Ghazipur and Azamgarh. By the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, Om Prakash Rajbhar had joined BJP, yet SP’s position remained strong. SP won 12 out of 21 Lok Sabha seats on its own, covering 56 Assembly segments. This meant SP gained a lead in 26 seats within two years. BJP won 8 Lok Sabha seats, covering 41 Assembly segments, meaning it fell behind in 12 seats during this period. This is why SP is focusing on strengthening its position in Eastern UP. Influential parties like Nishad Party and SBSP are currently aligned with BJP. To counter this, SP has appointed Seema Rajbhar as National President of Women’s Wing and Rukmani Devi Nishad, sister of Phoolan Devi, as State President. However, both are not major political figures. Still, by giving them key positions, SP aims to send a message of empowering backward-class women. Western UP remains a major challenge without alliance SP’s caste-based strategy now focuses on 136 seats in Western UP. In 2022, it benefited from RLD’s support, but this time it faces the challenge of contesting independently. That is why SP has already begun its campaign from Dadri. Apart from Jats, Gurjars are another important vote bank in Western UP. To attract them, SP held a “Samajwadi Samta Bhai-chara Rally” in Dadri on March 29. Considering the importance of the region, SP is also organizing its “Vision India” programme in Ghaziabad on April 25. This is a nationwide youth outreach campaign aimed at presenting the party’s roadmap for the 2027 elections. Another similar programme is planned in Noida by the end of May. Chandrashekhar alliance could change political equations Senior journalist Ravindra Singh Rana, who closely follows Western UP politics, says that if SP forms an alliance with Chandrashekhar, it could benefit significantly. A large section of Jatav voters is currently with Chandrashekhar. Among Jat leaders, SP has names like Harendra Malik, Pankaj Malik, and Samarpal Singh. In recent times, Akhilesh Yadav’s strategy of promoting young leaders is also showing results. For example, he recently praised Meerut-based young Jat leader Samrat Malik’s jacket, after which Malik arrived in Lucknow wearing a similar jacket, which was publicly highlighted by Akhilesh, sending a strong message among youth and the community.

stories.title: Family returning from daughter's wedding killed in car crash:5 dead as Scorpio hits trailer; pet dog also dies
stories.summary: 5 people, including a couple and their son, were killed in a horrific road accident in Uttar Pradesh’s Mau early on Saturday. The family was returning to Gorakhpur in a Scorpio after their daughter’s wedding in Ranchi when the vehicle suddenly went out of control at around 3 am on the highway, broke through the divider and entered the opposite lane, where it collided head-on with an oncoming trailer. After the crash, the Scorpio was badly crushed and all occupants were trapped inside. Local residents and police somehow managed to pull them out, but by then all 5 had died. The accident took place under Doharighat police station limits. Preliminary investigation suggests the driver may have dozed off at the wheel. According to police, those killed were Vinay Srivastava (53), his wife Archana Srivastava (48), and their son Kritarth (27), all residents of Ranidiha in Gorakhpur. The two drivers — Nitish Kumar (20) and Purushottam Kumar (28) — were residents of Gaya in Bihar. Family was returning after daughter’s wedding Vinay Srivastava, a resident of Khorabar village in Gorakhpur, had travelled to Ranchi for the wedding of his daughter Vimansa, which took place on April 20. After the wedding ceremonies concluded, the family hired a Scorpio and left Ranchi for Gorakhpur — a journey of around 558 km — on April 24. Since the distance was long, two drivers were travelling with the family. After covering nearly 400 km, the vehicle had reached near Kusumha Basharatpur. At the time of the accident, Purushottam was driving, while Vinay Srivastava was seated beside him in the front passenger seat. On the middle seat were Archana, son Kritarth, and the family’s pet dog. The second driver, Nitish, was resting in the rear seat. Police said the vehicle was travelling at a speed of around 90 to 100 kmph at the time of the crash. Police suspect driver Purushottam nodded off briefly, causing the Scorpio to break through the divider and enter the opposite lane. A speeding trailer was coming from the other side, and the SUV was hit head-on. After the collision, the trailer dragged the Scorpio several metres. The trailer driver fled the spot after the accident. Vehicle cut open with gas cutter to recover bodies The impact of the collision was so severe that the sound was heard several kilometres away. Villagers from nearby areas rushed to the spot and informed police. Station House Officer Sanjay Kumar Tripathi reached the scene, but by then all five occupants had died. Police initially tried to pull the bodies out, but they were trapped so badly inside the mangled vehicle that rescue was impossible. A gas cutter and tractor were then brought in. The Scorpio was cut open with the gas cutter, and the tractor was used to pull it away from the trailer. Only then were the bodies recovered. The bodies were badly mutilated — some had crushed limbs, while in some cases faces were unrecognisable. Police have informed the family members.

stories.title: Father murders 3-year-old son in Jhansi, then dies by suicide:Child sleeping next to mother, taken away at night
stories.summary: In a shocking incident in Jhansi, a father allegedly slit the throat of his three-year-old son before dying by suicide. The child had been sleeping beside his mother when the accused, who returned late at night after attending a neighbour’s wedding, allegedly picked him up and took him into another room. Police said the man was under the influence of alcohol. He locked the room from inside and carried out the act. At around 2 am, when his wife woke up, she found the child missing. The room was locked from inside. When she looked through the window, she saw her son lying dead on the floor, while her husband was hanging inside the room. Family members rushed to the spot after being informed, and police were alerted. Police have taken both bodies into custody and started an investigation into the matter. The incident took place in Dhimpura village under Raksa police station limits.

stories.title: Shopkeeper burnt alive as fire breaks out in Kanpur market:5 including wife, daughter injured; firefighters rescue family with ladders
stories.summary: A massive fire broke out in three shops in Kanpur’s Dina Market in Ghatampur at around 3:30 am on Saturday, killing a shopkeeper after he was burnt alive, while five family members suffered burn injuries. Fire brigade personnel used ladders to rescue those trapped on the first floor, and five fire tenders have been battling the blaze for the past five hours. Preliminary investigation suggests the fire started in one of the shops due to a short circuit. Within minutes, the flames spread rapidly and engulfed all three shops, completely reducing the goods kept inside to ashes. The three shops belonged to brothers from the same family. The shops were on the ground floor, while 15 members of the three brothers’ families lived on the first floor above them. See pictures of the incident Family was asleep when fire broke out Three real brothers — Ramkishan, Satyanarayan and Rajjanlal, residents of Behta Buzurg — owned shops in Dina Market. One was a grocery shop, another a clothing shop, and the third a wholesale biscuit shop. Their home was built directly above the shops, and the family lived there. As usual, on Friday night, the three brothers shut their shops and went upstairs, where they had dinner with their respective families before going to sleep. On Saturday morning, locals noticed smoke billowing out from the shops and raised an alarm. Hearing the commotion, eldest brother Ramkishan (70) woke up. When he saw flames in the lower portion of the building, he moved towards a room to alert his son. At that moment, a thick cloud of smoke engulfed him, causing him to collapse unconscious. Moments later, he was surrounded by flames and died after being burnt alive. Fire personnel later recovered his body, which has now been sent for postmortem. In the incident, Ramkishan’s wife Gomti (66) and son Hariom (40), also known as Panak, suffered burns. Hariom’s wife Shreya and their four-month-old son Shivarth were also injured in the blaze. Ayushi, daughter of Ramkishan’s brother Satyanarayan, also sustained burn injuries. All five injured have been admitted to Ghatampur CHC for treatment. Five rescued through ladder operation All five injured were trapped on the first floor when the fire intensified. Fire brigade personnel mounted ladders and carried out a rescue operation to bring them out safely. Even hours after the blaze began, five fire engines remained at the spot trying to fully control the fire. ‘Before we could understand, the fire had reached our room’ Satyanarayan’s son Ankur said everything was reduced to ashes in the fire. He said the family was asleep when shouting outside woke them up. When they got up, they found the house filled with smoke. “Before we could understand anything, the fire had reached the room. Somehow, we ran and saved our lives,” he said. He added that his uncle died after being caught in the flames, while several other family members suffered burns. Tehsildar reaches spot, assures help As soon as information about the incident was received, Ghatampur Tehsildar Ankita Pathak reached the spot. She gathered details of the incident from the family and assured them of all possible assistance.

stories.title: ₹300 electricity bill rises to ₹60,000:Lucknow residents allege forced smart power meter installation
stories.summary: “My house has a solar panel installed, because of which my electricity bill earlier used to be around ₹300. But after a prepaid meter was installed, I suddenly received a bill of ₹60,000. I deposited ₹10,000, yet within just 15 days, only around ₹350 balance remained in my account.” Saying this, Yash Gupta, a resident of LDA Colony in Rajajipuram, demanded that the smart meter be replaced. In fact, electricity consumers in Lucknow have been continuously protesting against the forced installation of prepaid smart meters. More than 20 protests have been held in the city so far. Aggrieved consumers are surrounding councillors in protest. Consumers allege that even after depositing money, they are having to wait 5–6 hours — and in many cases an entire day — for electricity supply to be restored. A ground team visited to understand people’s problems. Here is what consumers had to say. See 3 pictures... Councillors surrounded; consumers say prepaid meters will not be accepted In Lucknow, consumers troubled by prepaid smart meters surrounded councillor Rahul Mishra in the Raja Bazar area. Distressed women consumers said that ever since prepaid meters were installed, readings have started showing higher consumption. Power cuts are happening at any time. Officials replaced the meters without any prior information, which they called wrong. Councillor Rahul Mishra said the public is suffering and officials are not paying attention to their complaints. He said authorities have been approached several times, but the problem remains unresolved. He demanded that smart meters be removed. Congress leader of the Municipal Councillors’ Group, Mamta Chaudhary, also raised the issue. Along with affected consumers from Habibnagar, Malviyanagar and Darugodam, she submitted a memorandum to the Superintending Engineer (Commercial, Central Zone). Mamta Chaudhary said complaints of incorrect billing have increased after the installation of smart meters. She alleged that these meters were installed forcibly. Officials had been instructed to install check meters, but despite that, consumers are getting no relief. She said officials have become unaccountable, ordinary people are not being heard, and the poor are facing increasing hardship. Memorandum submitted to local councillor on April 18 Women from Mankameshwar Ward had approached local councillor Ranjit Singh Yadav on Saturday with complaints regarding smart meters. The women said that since the installation of smart meters, electricity bills have increased sharply. Continuous negative balance readings are resulting in electricity disconnections. The councillor forwarded the complaint to MLA Neeraj Bora and assured action. He said problems have increased because of smart meters. Poor families are suffering. He also alleged that prepaid meters were converted from postpaid without informing consumers. Following this, MLA Neeraj Bora wrote a letter to the Energy Minister over the matter. Week-long protest at Laulai substation At Chinhat’s Laulai substation, electricity consumers staged continuous protests for a week. Residents of Kanshiram Awas Yojana alleged that 2,200 flats had their postpaid meters converted into prepaid meters without any prior notice. They said meter readings that used to be around ₹200 are now reaching ₹500, while electricity connections are being cut at any time without information. Local MLA Yogesh Shukla and councillor Mamta Rawat also joined the protest. The MLA visited the protest site more than twice and assured action. ‘First replace the meter, then we will talk’ Anger among residents of Indira Nagar was visible at the Sector-14 power house. On April 16, people gathered there and raised slogans against Madhyanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited, Energy Minister A.K. Sharma and departmental officials. After nearly an hour of protest at the power house, officials said they would inspect the problem. After this, officials walked nearly 1 km along with the protesting residents to their village. On the spot, people said that whenever they deposit a bill, it turns negative again within a short time. Following this, officials and staff checked the meters in the village. During this, women said the prepaid meters must first be replaced — only then would there be any further discussion. ‘We realised after three days that power had been cut’ Elderly Bachchi Devi, a resident of the KKC area, broke down in tears while narrating her ordeal at the 1912 control room complaint centre. She said she had been ill and could not deposit the electricity bill on time. According to her, power supply to her house remained cut for three days. After facing great difficulty, she came to know about it, following which she paid the bill. She said her bill was around ₹1,000, which she has now deposited. ‘A ₹60,000 bill came suddenly’ Yash Gupta said his household electricity consumption is 7–8 units, while the solar panel installed at his home generates up to 8 units of electricity. He said he is still being billed for that electricity, whereas the amount should instead be deducted. He demanded that a check meter be installed at his home. Women demand replacement of prepaid meters Lajjawati, a resident of Panditpurwa, said her smart meter should be removed immediately and the old meter reinstalled. She alleged that electricity department officials and employees pressured her household into forcibly installing a smart meter. “We are uneducated and could not properly understand what was being installed. Now we are receiving electricity bills of around ₹6,000 every month, which we cannot afford to pay,” she said, demanding that the meter be changed back to the old one. 'No hearing despite complaint' Soni Devi of Panditpurwa, who reached the Indira Nagar Sector-14 power house with her complaint, said her area is facing repeated power cuts, disrupting daily life. She added that despite frequent outages, money continues to be deducted through billing. “Even after complaints, nobody is listening. The meter should be changed. That is what we want,” she said.

stories.title: Girl confronts robber fleeing after looting jewelry:Grabbed hand and slammed on road; had entered the shop posing as customers
stories.summary: In Gorakhpur on Monday afternoon, a jeweler's shop was robbed. Two young men entered the shop posing as customers. Then, seizing the opportunity, they snatched approximately 20 grams of gold and started fleeing. However, the shop owner's 18-year-old daughter showed courage. She chased the criminals for about 100 meters. During this, she caught one criminal by the hand and brought him down. She also beat him. During this, the girl's hand got injured. Despite this, both criminals escaped. This entire incident was captured on CCTV, and a video of it has also surfaced. Upon receiving information, the police reached the spot and started investigation. The incident is from Ward No. 17 of Gola suburb. See the girl's bravery in 3 pictures... Now know the complete matter In Ward No. 17, there is a jewelry shop named Devansh Swarnkala Kendra. The shop owner Rakesh Verma had gone to distribute cards for his elder daughter's engagement. In Rakesh's absence, his younger daughter Amrita was managing the shop. Amrita said - Around 2:20 PM in the afternoon, two youths entered my shop posing as customers. They asked to see jewelry. As soon as I showed them the jewelry, one youth found an opportunity and snatched it. He grabbed 4-5 pairs of earrings weighing about 20 grams. After that, he started running from the shop. I caught one youth and threw him to the ground Amrita immediately raised an alarm and herself ran after the criminals. She crossed the shop's threshold in one go and came onto the road. Here she caught one criminal's hand and made him fall. But that criminal pushed Amrita and escaped. During this, Amrita's hand also got injured. Shop owner Rakesh Verma, who reached the shop after being informed about the incident, said - The value of the stolen 20 grams of gold is approximately 2 lakh 50 thousand rupees. Now read what is visible in the CCTV At the beginning of the video, silence is visible in the alley. Some bikes are parked. A person wearing a red T-shirt and black pants is moving forward in the alley holding a water bottle in his hand. As soon as the person in the red T-shirt moves ahead, 2 young men are seen running from behind. A girl is chasing them. Suddenly the girl catches one of the young men. She throws him to the ground. The young man tries to free himself, which leads to a scuffle between the two. The young man pushes the girl and both of them fall to the ground. The young woman is seen continuously screaming and shouting. After this, the young man frees himself and runs away. His companion was standing with a bike near Sarya Vegetable Market. He escaped with him. Dr. Anil Tiwari's clinic is in front of the jewelry shop. He says, The girl has sustained an injury to her hand, which has been treated. The injury is not serious. It was a minor injury. After treatment, the girl has been sent home. Station In-charge Rakesh Roshan Singh said, The matter is being investigated based on the complaint from the victim's side. Police reached the spot as soon as information about the incident was received. The accused are being searched for based on CCTV footage.

stories.title: IPS Ajay Pal enters Bengal polls:Encounter specialist warns intimidators to stay within limits; vows strict action if they don’t
stories.summary: UP's encounter specialist IPS Ajay Pal Sharma has made a spectacular entry in the Bengal elections. Ajay Pal has given a stern warning to Trinamool Congress candidate Jahangir Khan. He said, if the public is scared or threatened, strict action will be taken. Then don't cry or regret. A video of Ajay Pal Sharma's action has also surfaced. IPS Ajay Pal had received complaints against TMC leader Jahangir Khan for intimidating voters. After this, he himself reached the spot. Under his leadership, teams of SSB, FST and QRT conducted a raid. Jahangir Khan is considered close to CM Mamata Banerjee's nephew Abhishek Banerjee, so this action has further increased the political temperature. The Election Commission has appointed 11 observers for the second phase of elections in Bengal, but IPS Ajay Pal is being discussed the most. See photos First know, what did Ajay Pal Sharma appear to say in the VIDEO? 2 videos of 18 and 15 seconds have surfaced. In these, IPS Ajaypal Sharma is saying, 'Then we will take good care of him. Jahangir's family members are also standing here. Tell him properly. These reports that keep coming that his people are threatening, then we will take good care of it. Don't cry and regret later.' Fear of Jahangir was such that people were not revealing his house address Trinamool Congress has given a party ticket to Jahangir Khan from the Falta assembly constituency in South 24 Parganas district. Jahangir is 41 years old and has passed 12th grade. IPS Ajay Pal Sharma is the observer of South 24 Parganas district. Serious allegations were being made against Jahangir Khan for intimidating and threatening local people. As soon as the complaint was received, IPS Ajay Pal Sharma reached the spot with his team. Ajay Pal Sharma asked the local police and villagers for Jahangir Khan's house address, but everyone was hesitant to tell. Finally, after a search, his team found Jahangir's house. Candidate has Y category security, 14 deployed instead of 10 When Ajay Pal Sharma reached the house of TMC candidate Jahangir Khan, 14 personnel of Bengal Police were found deployed for security. Upon seeking information from the local SP, it was revealed that Jahangir has been provided only 10 policemen under Y category security. Ajay Pal Sharma took a strict stance regarding the 4 additional policemen deployed on the spot and issued a notice to the local SP demanding an answer as to why additional force was deployed in violation of rules? Voting will be held on 142 seats on April 29 For the West Bengal Assembly Elections 2026, voting has already taken place on 152 seats in the first phase on April 23. Barring sporadic incidents, the polling was peaceful. The second phase of voting is to be held on April 29. Votes will be cast on a total of 142 seats including Kolkata. Considering the sensitivity of the second phase, the Election Commission has sent 11 new police observers to Bengal. One of them is IPS Ajay Pal Sharma. From dental surgeon to encounter specialist, know about Ajay Pal Sharma Ajay Pal Sharma, who became an IPS officer in 2011 from being a dentist, is also known as an 'Encounter Specialist'. He has conducted more than 500 encounters in his 15-year career. In these, 15 criminals were killed, while others were arrested. 136 Encounters in 22 Months Dr. Ajay Pal Sharma, an IPS officer from Ludhiana, Punjab, was a dental surgeon before joining the IPS. He obtained his BDS (Dental Sciences) degree from Government Medical College, Patiala. His younger brother Amit Pal Sharma is an IAS officer. 41-year-old Ajay Pal is currently posted as Additional CP (Law and Order) in Prayagraj. Prior to this, he has served as SP/SSP in five districts. During his 22-month tenure as SP in Jaunpur, he conducted a record 136 encounters. This is the highest number of encounters during any SP's tenure in any district. Took charge of these districts He has been the captain of Hathras, Shamli, Rampur and Jaunpur. In 2013, he was posted as ASP at the Kumbh Mela organized in Prayagraj. He was also given responsibility as SP Personnel and captain of UP-112 at Police Headquarters. Woman had made serious allegations Ajay Pal Sharma's career has been filled not only with successes but also with controversies. In 2020, a woman named Deepti Sharma had made serious allegations against him. The woman claimed that Ajay Pal had married her in 2016 and later backed out. This case escalated to such an extent that an FIR was registered against him at Hazratganj police station in Lucknow and an SIT investigation was also set up. Due to this controversy, his promotion remained stuck for a long time, although he was later given a clean chit. Was Nodal Officer at Mahakumbh Just before the Mahakumbh, he was posted as Nodal Officer (Mahakumbh, Commissionerate Prayagraj). On December 22, 2024, he was made Additional CP Prayagraj. During this period, he played an important role in the successful organization of Mahakumbh. After Mahakumbh, he was assigned the responsibility of Additional CP (Law and Order) Prayagraj.

stories.title: Youth’s head, arm and leg severed after dumper collision:Flung onto highway railing, neck cut on impact
stories.summary: In Bijnor, a young man's head was severed from his body after colliding with an iron railing on the roadside. Actually, a speeding dumper hit the young man and he flew several feet in the air and fell on the railing. This caused his neck to be cut. His left hand and right leg were also severed. Blood spread several meters around. When people from nearby rushed to the spot, the young man had already died. His head, torso, one hand and leg were scattered. After hitting him, the driver fled with the dumper. This incident occurred late Sunday night near Rehra Bus Stand on NH-734. The young man could be identified on Monday morning. He has been identified as Balraj Singh from Dahlawala village. He worked at a gas agency. According to his brother, he had gone out for a walk after dinner late at night when this accident occurred. 2 pictures of the accident Brother said, 'Sister's wedding preparations were underway' Balraj Singh (32), a resident of Dahlawala village in Rehri police station area, is one of three brothers. Balraj was the youngest and was unmarried. His elder brother Sompal Singh works in a private job in Noida. He lives there with his family. While the second brother Khub Singh lives in the village. He is divorced from his wife. According to elder brother Sompal Singh, Balraj worked at a gas agency and was on leave for his sister's wedding. One of his cousin sisters is getting married on April 30 and another on May 8. Tuesday is his sister's engagement ceremony. As usual, after having dinner at night, he had left home for a walk. He was crossing NH-734 about 300 meters from home. At that moment, a speeding dumper hit him hard. The impact was so severe that he flew several feet in the air and crashed into an iron railing. As he fell on it, his neck was severed and separated from his torso. Due to falling on the railing, his left hand and right leg were also cut off and separated. When the accident occurred, people from nearby rushed to the spot. They saw the young man's head, torso, one hand and leg scattered separately. Police arrived upon receiving information. The body was sent for post-mortem. Due to the face being severely crushed, identification could not be done immediately. On Monday, police identified Balraj and informed his family members. There was chaos at home upon receiving news of the youth's death. Station in-charge said, ‘Search for dumper driver is underway’ Rehri Station In-charge Rajiv Kumar said, On Sunday, a youth died in an accident after being hit by a dumper. Information has been given to his elder brother. The dumper driver is being searched for.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:Triple murder accused shot in encounter; Iran fires at ship carrying 12 Indians
stories.summary: 1. Iran fires on Togo-flagged ship with 12 Indians on board A Togo-flagged chemical tanker, MT Siron, carrying Indian sailors, came under tension near Oman after the Iranian Coast Guard fired warning shots during an intervention, officials said. The incident occurred on April 25 at the Shinas Outer Port limits in Oman, where the vessel had been boarded by individuals while sailing near other ships. Authorities confirmed that all 12 Indian crew members on board are safe. 2. Triple murder accused in cake row shot in encounter; Bulandshahr Police hits leg, gym faces bulldozer Police on Monday morning shot Mayank Saini, accused in the murder of three friends over a birthday cake row in Bulandshahr, in an encounter. He sustained a bullet injury to his leg and was admitted to the district hospital. Authorities have also initiated bulldozer action against the gym where the killings took place. 3. Bulldozer razes Maulana Shamsul Huda’s madrasa: Held British citizenship, drew lakhs in salary from UP A bulldozer was used to demolish Maulana Shamsul Huda’s madrasa in Sant Kabir Nagar. The cleric had earlier worked as a teacher at a madrasa in Azamgarh and later acquired British citizenship in 2007. He has been accused of receiving foreign funding. The case was probed by the ATS, which registered a case against him at the Kotwali police station. 4. TMC MP alleges attack on car by BJP workers, saffron party rejects charges TMC MP Mitali Bag, was attacked in the Hooghly district of West Bengal on Monday. TMC alleged that BJP supporters targeted her vehicle in Goghat, pelting it with bricks and stones and striking it with sticks. Bag was en route from Goghat to Arambagh to attend a roadshow led by Abhishek Banerjee when the incident occurred. 5. Akhilesh follows Mulayam's 'Halla Bol' footprint: SP to reach victim's home without informing administration Akhilesh Yadav has made a fresh political move in Uttar Pradesh. Now, after any incident or accident, Samajwadi Party leaders will visit affected families without informing the administration. The focus will remain on PDA — backward classes, Dalits and minorities. 6. Gorakhpur house catches fire after AC short circuit A fire broke out on Monday morning in a four-storey house in Mirzapur area under Rajghat police station limits in Gorakhpur. The blaze started on the third floor, after which family members ran downstairs screaming for help. People living nearby immediately informed the police and the Golghar fire station. 7. Arvind Kejriwal refuses to appear before HC in liquor scam case Former Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal has refused to appear in the High Court in the liquor scam case. He said his hope of getting justice from Justice Swarnakanta Sharma had been broken. He said he would neither appear in the High Court nor present arguments. 8. Varanasi businessman beaten to death by angry villagers A man died after being beaten by a mob in Varanasi following an incident where his car reportedly hit a woman. The angry crowd allegedly assaulted the businessman with kicks, punches and bricks until he died. His car was also damaged in the attack. 9. BJP district chief accused of seeking sexual favours for VP post In Mahoba, former district minister Deepali Tiwari has levelled serious allegations against district president Mohanlal Kushwaha. She claims she was subjected to unethical pressure to engage in a sexual relationship in exchange for the post of district vice-president. Kushwaha has strongly denied the allegations, calling them a conspiracy to tarnish his image. 10. India-New Zealand sign free trade deal India and New Zealand signed a free trade agreement (FTA) on Monday, 27 April, 2026 to boost trade of goods and services between the two countries and promote investments. Minister of Commerce and Industry said its a win-win situation for citizens of both the countries.

stories.title: Yogi warns cow slaughterers of consequences:Accuses Mamata of street namaz politics; says, 'TMC goons will repair punctures after polls'
stories.summary: CM Yogi again reached West Bengal on Monday, the last day of election campaigning. Here he held a roadshow and a public meeting. He said - In Bengal, Mamata Didi gets angry when slogans of Jai Shri Ram and Har Har Mahadev are raised. She sees her power shaking. In a double-engine government, there will be no ban on saying Jai Shri Ram, but Iftar feasts on the streets will definitely stop. When the results come on April 4, TMC goons will be seen making punctures on the road. The CM said - In 2017, a double-engine government came to power in UP. Today, hooliganism and riots have ended. Daughters and traders are safe. Love Jihad and Land Jihad are banned. He gave the slogan - We will not let cows be slaughtered. We will not let Hindus be divided. The CM said- In UP today, no one kills cows, and if they do, they will suffer the consequences. No mafia can threaten any trader. No one can seize a trader's property. If they do, UP's bulldozer will crush them.CM Yogi held a roadshow in Dumdum and Kalyani assembly constituencies, while addressing a public meeting in Dhankhali assembly constituency. Now he will address a rally in Rajarhat Gopalpur. 1. Bengal government is conspiring to change the demography of the state Yogi said Bengal is the land of India’s self-respect and honour, a sacred land that has elevated India’s heritage. He said this is the land of Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, who spread the message of “Hare Krishna, Hare Rama” through kirtan. He added that Bengal is also the land of Ramakrishna Paramahamsa. Recalling Swami Vivekananda, he said it was from this land that the message was given to say with pride that we are Hindus. He alleged that today, the Bengal government is conspiring to change the state’s demography. 2. ‘Jai Shri Ram’ is banned in Bengal The CM said this is the same land that ignited the flame of the 1857 revolt, beginning from Barrackpore. He said this is the land where Khudiram Bose embraced the gallows with a smile, and which gave the slogan of Swadeshi during the 1905 partition of Bengal. He added that Bengal was once called India’s cultural capital and an economic engine due to its industries. Questioning its current state, he said that under a “double-engine” BJP government, the Taraknath Temple would get a grand corridor like Kashi Vishwanath, with better facilities for devotees and organised opportunities for traders. He blamed Congress, Communists and TMC for pushing Bengal towards economic decline. BJP leader Tejasvi Surya was also seen with Yogi in his roadshow. Yogi waved his hand, accepting people's greetings. 3. Restriction on speaking about Sanatan tradition in Bengal Yogi said that in Bengal, speaking about India’s Sanatan tradition is prohibited. He claimed that chanting “Jai Shri Ram” is banned, and that processions for idol immersion during Durga Puja and visarjan are restricted. The CM said unrest begins before Hindu festivals in Bengal, with curfews imposed. He alleged that open cow slaughter takes place and incidents of “Love Jihad” and “Land Jihad” occur, while the TMC remains silent. He added that Bengal has now begun raising its voice against this, and said he has come from Uttar Pradesh to speak against hooliganism and misgovernance. 4. Open cow slaughter is happening, but TMC is silent Yogi said a similar situation existed in Uttar Pradesh before 2017, with widespread hooliganism and mafias running parallel systems of power. He alleged that cow slaughter and disorderly activities were common, and unrest would precede festivals. The CM said he visited Burrabazar in Kolkata, where, according to him, TMC workers had occupied the heritage mansion of Rabindranath Tagore and hoisted party flags, which were later removed following a court order. He alleged that such occupations happen widely, but after the first phase of voting on April 23, fear has set in among them and they are now looking for places to hide.

stories.title: 'Sleep with me, and I will make you district vice-president':BJP woman leader in Mahoba accuses district chief of sexual favours demand for post
stories.summary: In Mahoba, former district minister Deepali Tiwari has levelled serious allegations against district president Mohanlal Kushwaha. She claims she was subjected to unethical pressure to engage in a sexual relationship in exchange for the post of district vice-president. Kushwaha has strongly denied the allegations, calling them a conspiracy to tarnish his image. The internal rift within the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in Mahoba has now spilled onto the streets and social media. Discontent had been brewing since the formation of the new district executive, but the issue escalated into a major political controversy after Tiwari’s Facebook Live. Deepali Tiwari has directly accused Kushwaha of imposing inappropriate conditions for the position. She alleged that when she discussed the possibility of becoming district vice-president, he placed a condition that left her shocked. According to her, he suggested that she accompany him to Delhi and Lucknow, and threatened to remove her from the post or expel her from the party if she refused. Deepali also alleged that two other party office-bearers—the district general secretary and a district vice-president—pressured her to comply with the district president’s demands. Speaking emotionally, she said she had been devoted to the party for years, but her patience broke when she was threatened that her husband would be falsely implicated in a rape case, forcing her to go public through a Facebook Live. Meanwhile, district president Mohanlal Kushwaha has dismissed all the allegations as baseless and fabricated. He said there is no truth in the claims made on social media and described them as a conspiracy to damage his reputation. He has strongly condemned and denied the accusations. Deepali Tiwari has already resigned from her post, but her allegations have triggered a political stir in Mahoba. While signs of internal discord within the BJP are becoming more visible, the opposition has also found an opportunity to turn the issue into a political flashpoint. It now remains to be seen what stance the party leadership will take in the matter.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav asks BJP to stop arson:Mocks BJP woman MLA; says, 'They can’t even make effigies'
stories.summary: SP chief Akhilesh Yadav took a jibe at BJP over the massive fires in Lucknow-Ghaziabad. He said, "I request BJP people to stop setting fires. Many people have been burnt. In such heat, women have been brought out on the streets. Whereas, women themselves are saying that if reservation was to be given, why not give it this time itself. Why not implement it now. This means BJP people came with things as part of a well-thought-out strategy. Taking a jibe at BJP woman MLA, he said, "I have heard that someone has suffered a lot of damage. While preparing for opposition, they couldn't even understand how to make an effigy. Actually, 2 days ago in Bahraich, BJP MLA Anupama Jaiswal got burnt while burning effigies of Akhilesh and Rahul Gandhi. She was protesting with BJP workers regarding the Nari Shakti Vandan Act. Akhilesh said on the death of a daughter of Vishwakarma community in Ghazipur- Our people were treated badly. Some new sections have been added there, the papers have not reached us. When BJP people cannot do it themselves, they are getting it done through others. We have decided that we will provide assistance of 5 lakhs to the affected family. Before me, a delegation will go again tomorrow, which will include Jai Kishan Sahu, Ram Asare Vishwakarma and SP Mahila Sabha President Seema Rajbhar. Key Points of Akhilesh's Press Conference 1. Will work to ensure rights for PDA people The SP chief said, "Nowadays it's the era of social media. In such times, I am happy to release a coffee table book based on a collection of 100 years of photographs. India's honor is increasing, and AMU has a major contribution in this. Big personalities have studied and emerged from old universities like AMU and BHU. He said - The threat that has emerged to Hindustaniyat (Indian ethos), we are the ones dealing with it. We hope that PDA people will work to secure rights. Whether it takes years or a century for this, we are not going to back down. Aligarh Muslim University was supposed to start in Ghazipur, but later it was built in Aligarh. 2. Government's claims on women's safety are hollow Akhilesh said on the Ghazipur incident, “Those who do not want to run by the Constitution, those who want to run by their own whims, we will deal with them too. False cases are being filed against our people. If the family members had some suspicion, was it investigated or not? Where the daughter's body was found, there wasn't even two feet of water there.” He said, "Since the BJP government has been formed in UP, such incidents have increased, because the Chief Minister doesn't stay here at all. Everyone leaves with him. The government's claims about women's safety are proving to be hollow. Let the new delegation go, our date is fixed. What is the police trying to hide. 3. Will make payment to farmers within 24 hours of forming government The SP chief said, “There was a SP program in Ghaziabad. Programs are being held under Vision India. In this, discussions were held on why farmers are troubled, why they are suffering. Many suggestions came. If work is done on them after forming the government, farmers will be prosperous. Farmers are fighting for payment. After forming the government, we will make payment to farmers within 24 hours. We are also going to organize a program for weavers. We were giving them free electricity earlier. In future, we will honor the weavers.” 4. Food items, diesel and petrol are all going to become expensive Deputy CM Brajesh Pathak's name was not mentioned, but Akhilesh said, “The Health Department itself needs treatment. Until these people are removed, the Health Department will not improve. As soon as elections are over, food items, diesel and petrol will all become expensive.”

stories.title: 'Cannot bear to see suffering of mother cow':Youth insists on meeting CM Yogi Adityanath in Lucknow; police drags him away
stories.summary: In Lucknow, cow protector Deepak Kumar staged a protest at CM Chowk. Wearing saffron clothes and hanging posters around his neck, Deepak sat on a dharna demanding that cows be given the status of National Gau Mata (Mother Cow). Police arrived at the spot and tried to remove him, but Deepak remained firm on his demands. Police dragged Deepak away from there. During this, Deepak raised the issue of Gau Mata's suffering and demanded that the government make strict laws. 'Cannot bear to see Gau Mata's suffering' Deepak, a resident of Bulandshahr, said that we cannot bear the suffering of Gau Mata (Mother Cow). Our Gau Mata suffers in slaughterhouses and other places. Today, we have come to meet the Chief Minister and submit a memorandum to him so that strict laws are made for this, and the cow is given the status of National Gau Mata. He said that the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh is a sadhu and saint. If the status of National Gau Mata is not achieved during his tenure, then it will be a matter of great shame for us. 'Insistence on meeting CM Yogi' Deepak said that we are serving Gau Mata throughout the state. Our life is dedicated to cow service. We are seeing how our cow, which we consider as mother, suffers, and people with criminal mentality make them their victims. Therefore, for the past several years, we have been struggling to save the life of Gau Mata. This struggle will continue until we get the status of National Gau Mata. Today we have come to appeal to the head of Uttar Pradesh, but the police are not allowing us to meet CM Yogi. Campaign will run across entire India Deepak appealed saying that we request all our Sanatan brothers and sisters to support us in this campaign. We will fight this battle at the national level, from UP to Delhi, meeting everyone from CM Yogi to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, and will get laws made for the protection of Gau Mata (Mother Cow).

stories.title: Fiancee Priya cheers Rinku’s 4 sixes, says ‘once more':Watches LSG vs KKR IPL match with Akhilesh Yadav’s daughters
stories.summary: At Ekana Stadium, Rinku’s fiancée, MP Priya Saroj, was thrilled by his four sixes. She said, “Today Rinku Singh played a brilliant innings for my father-in-law. We are missing him a lot today.” She was also seen celebrating his innings in the stadium with the KKR flag. Cheering his sixes, Priya said, “Once more, Rinku.” Meanwhile, after winning the match, Rinku made his mother and sister speak to Sunil Narine on a video call. During this, his sister said, “You bowled very well today, brother.” Rinku also made his mother speak to Sunil Narine on a video call. During the match, both daughters of Samajwadi Party chief and former Chief Minister Akhilesh Yadav—Aditi Yadav and Tina Yadav—were also present with them. See 3 pictures... Won on the first ball of the Super Over The 38th match of IPL-2026 was played at Ekana on Sunday, April 26. Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) defeated Lucknow Super Giants (LSG). Rinku Singh was the hero of the match. He scored an unbeaten 83 runs off 51 balls. He took 5 catches while fielding. In the last over of the match, he hit 4 consecutive sixes off Dhruv Rathi's bowling. He won the match for his team by hitting a four on the first ball of the Super Over.

stories.title: Businessman beaten to death by mob after car hits woman:Enraged crowd assaults him mercilessly; FIR against 15, two arrested in Varanasi
stories.summary: A man died after being beaten by a mob in Varanasi following an incident where his car reportedly hit a woman. The angry crowd allegedly assaulted the businessman with kicks, punches and bricks until he died. His car was also damaged in the attack. The incident took place in the Phoolpur police station area. The deceased has been identified as Manish Singh, a resident of Bharathra village. He was returning home late on Sunday night after leaving his factory when a woman suddenly came in front of his car on the road. Following a complaint by the deceased’s uncle, police have registered an FIR against 8 named accused, including the woman’s relatives, and 7 unidentified people. Two accused have already been arrested. Now read the complete matter... Locals said that around midnight on Sunday, Manish was returning home from his factory by car. His factory, which produces dona-pattal, is located around 5 km from his house in the industrial area. When he entered the village route in Ghamahapur, a woman named Bindu Prajapati suddenly came in front of his vehicle. Although he applied brakes, the car hit the woman. Manish stopped the car and rushed to help her, calling out for villagers to assist in taking her to the hospital. People gathered at the spot, but instead of helping, they allegedly got into an argument with him. According to the deceased’s uncle Arun Singh, around 10–12 people surrounded Manish. They first damaged his car using bricks, and then began beating him. The businessman pleaded for mercy, but the attackers continued assaulting him with bricks. He collapsed on the road and died shortly after. Police informed after Manish's death After Manish’s death, police were informed by villagers. Phoolpur police reached the spot, sent the body for post-mortem, and informed the family. The injured woman was also taken to hospital. On the basis of the uncle’s complaint, police registered an FIR against 8 named and 7 unknown accused. Two people have been arrested. Under DCP Neetu Kadian and ADCP Nripendra Singh, police and PAC carried out a flag march in the village. The entire village has been turned into a police camp. Considering the tension, forces from five police stations along with PAC have been deployed. ADCP Gomti Zone Nripendra Singh said teams have been formed to arrest the remaining accused. The businessman got married 10 years ago Manish Singh (38) was married around 10 years ago to Ankita Singh. The couple has two daughters, Maitri Singh (8) and Chitra Singh (6), and a six-month-old son Bhairav Singh. His father Gulab Singh died 20 years ago and his mother passed away two years ago. He was the only son in the family. His two sisters, Manisha Singh and Monika Singh, are married.

stories.title: Akhilesh follows Mulayam's 'Halla Bol' footprint:SP to reach victim's home without informing administration; party's new strategy before elections
stories.summary: Akhilesh Yadav has made a fresh political move in Uttar Pradesh. Now, after any incident or accident, Samajwadi Party leaders will visit affected families without informing the administration. The focus will remain on PDA — backward classes, Dalits and minorities. The party has named this strategy ‘Guerrilla War’. A similar approach was followed during the tenure of Mulayam Singh Yadav as well. At that time, it was known as ‘Halla Bol’. In this backdrop, several questions are being raised — will the SP once again be seen on the streets, taking up struggles? What kind of incidents will trigger an aggressive stance? How effective will Akhilesh Yadav’s strategy prove? The answers to all these questions are part of this report. Why was there a need for 'Guerrilla War' In Ghazipur, on April 15, 2026, a girl from a backward caste died under suspicious circumstances. On April 22, when an SP delegation reached to meet the victim's family, they had a sharp clash with the villagers. Several people including former minister Ram Asare Vishwakarma were injured in the stone pelting. SP alleged that instead of taking action against the culprits, a case was filed against SP workers. After this, Akhilesh Yadav had said - Now there is no need to inform the police-administration to meet the victim's family, because they will stop our people. We will go without informing and expose the government's failure. We will work for the victim, so that they can get justice. SP returning to old strategy with time The Samajwadi Party has been away from the strategy of going on the ground and fighting for local issues for a long time. In even the biggest cases, Akhilesh Yadav either puts forth his point through social media or holds a press conference. Whereas, during Mulayam Singh's era, SP's approach used to be completely different. The party was known for taking to the streets and organizing large movements. Now after Akhilesh Yadav's announcement of 'Guerrilla War', it is being believed that SP will once again be visible on the streets for issues. SP's focus on incidents against PDA SP spokesperson Azam Khan said that any incident or accident occurs in any district and the police or any officer does not take action against the accused under some pressure. If the victim is harassed, then SP will help the victim's family. For this, the delegation will reach the victim's family without prior notice. It will provide legal assistance. The party's focus will remain on PDA. Special attention will be paid to incidents against backward, Dalit and minority communities. SP will benefit from raising local issues Senior journalist Yogesh Mishra, who has closely covered Samajwadi Party politics, says - Guerrilla war doesn't happen in politics. If it is being used in politics, then the meaning will change. There won't be a war here, but rather a verbal battle between BJP and SP and a race to capitalize on issues on the ground will be visible. Guerrilla war could also mean that if any big leader of BJP speaks against SP or makes a statement that SP can benefit from, then SP will directly launch a verbal attack on that leader instead of BJP. One aspect of this is also that Akhilesh Yadav is now strategizing to deal with the state government rather than the BJP at the center. Under this, he will raise such ground-level issues that directly connect with common people. If he succeeds in doing so, SP will benefit. 'Guerrilla War won't work in the era of AI' BJP spokesperson Avneesh Tyagi said that this is the era of AI. The era of guerrilla war neither existed in politics nor will it exist now. It is the era of ideas. The country's progress will happen only by moving forward together with everyone. He said, “By talking about things like gorilla war, which era does Akhilesh Yadav want to take UP to? By saying this, he is trying to push his workers into such a quagmire from where it will be difficult to get out. Now everyone has a mobile in their hand and every section is educated. They know the difference between right and wrong. In such a situation, it is impossible to mislead anyone by talking without work.”

stories.title: Gorakhpur house catches fire after AC short circuit:12 family members flee as flames engulf 4-storey home
stories.summary: A fire broke out on Monday morning in a four-storey house in Mirzapur area under Rajghat police station limits in Gorakhpur. The blaze started on the third floor, after which family members ran downstairs screaming for help. People living nearby immediately informed the police and the Golghar fire station. On receiving the information, Rajghat Police, along with the Fire Brigade, immediately began firefighting operations. Initial reports suggest the fire first broke out in a window AC on the third floor due to a short circuit, before spreading through the house. Following the incident, nearby residents also stepped out of their homes with their children as a precaution. See two pictures Fire suddenly breaks out at 8am Rishabh Kashyap, a dry fruits trader and resident of Mirzapur, said 12 members of his family live in the house. He said the AC installed near a third-floor window suddenly caught fire at around 8am. The flames gradually spread into the room. All family members immediately ran downstairs and managed to save themselves. The Fire Brigade team, which reached the spot after receiving information, continued efforts to douse the flames for around 45 minutes. Till 9.30am, the fire had not been brought under control. Since the house is located in a narrow lane, fire engines had to be parked at a distance, making rescue and firefighting efforts more difficult. Understanding the reasons behind AC fires There can be several reasons behind an AC blast or fire. One of the biggest causes is the lack of timely servicing. It is important to get an AC serviced once after every 600 hours of use. In simple terms, if you run your AC for 10 hours a day, it should be serviced after about two months. Running an AC continuously for several hours can also cause it to overheat. It should be switched off at intervals to allow its parts enough time to cool down. After running an AC continuously for four hours, it should ideally be given a break of at least 30 minutes. The outdoor unit of an AC should be installed in a place where it is not exposed to direct sunlight, as constant sun exposure can heat up the outdoor unit. If that is not possible, a protective shade can be installed above it. Apart from this, an AC should be operated mostly in Normal mode, as this reduces pressure on the compressor. Good-quality wiring, plugs, sockets and an MCB should always be installed for AC connections. The role of an MCB is to immediately cut off electricity in the event of even the smallest short circuit. The internal wiring of an AC should never be left loose and must always be tightened properly. Loose wiring during servicing or installation increases the risk of sparking inside the unit, which can trigger a fire.

He said advanced machines would be used for eye examinations, and glasses would be made available to customers according to their needs and budget. Eyes will be examined through 'Phoropter' machine Dr Prashant Srivastava, operator of Netram Optical Group, said this is the group’s fifth outlet. stories.title: Triple murder accused over cake row shot in encounter:Bulandshahr Police hits leg; gym where murders took place faces bulldozer
stories.summary: Police on Monday morning shot Mayank Saini, accused in the murder of three friends over a birthday cake row in Bulandshahr, in an encounter. He sustained a bullet injury to his leg and was admitted to the district hospital. Authorities have also initiated bulldozer action against the gym where the killings took place. Accused tried to flee, opened fire at police Circle Officer Shobhit Kumar said Mayank Saini was arrested around 3am. During questioning, he told police that the country-made pistol used in the crime had been hidden under a flyover. At around 5am, police took him to the spot identified by him. During the recovery operation, Mayank allegedly pushed a policeman, picked up the pistol and opened fire while trying to flee. In retaliatory firing by police, he was shot in the left leg and injured. Policemen carried him on their shoulders to the vehicle before taking him to hospital. Police recovered an illegal pistol and one empty cartridge from the spot. The encounter took place on Subhash Road in Khurja Nagar police station area. Pictures from the encounter spot… Birthday party turned into bloodshed The incident took place late Saturday night at RJS Fitness Gym, where birthday boy Jeetu Saini (30) allegedly shot dead the brother, cousin and nephew of a BJP councillor. Police have so far made two arrests and detained two others in connection with the case. Main accused Jeetu Saini remains absconding. Gym sealed, demolition notice pasted The gym where the triple murder took place has been sealed by the Bulandshahr Development Authority. A notice regarding illegal construction has been pasted outside the premises. The gym owner has been given time till 12 noon today to submit documents. If the gym map is found to be unapproved, the authority will carry out bulldozer action. Notices will also be pasted at the houses of the accused, giving them 24 hours to respond. How the entire incident unfolded Manish Saini, BJP councillor from Ward No. 24, said Jeetu had invited friends to a birthday party on Saturday. His brother Manish Saini (30), nephew Akash (19) and cousin Amardeep Saini (32) had gone to attend the celebration. Eyewitnesses told police that one of the victims smeared cake on Jeetu’s face, triggering his anger. An argument followed, after which Jeetu and his associates allegedly opened indiscriminate fire on the three. Rupesh Saini, a friend of Manish and the gym operator, informed the family over the phone. By the time relatives reached the spot, all three had died. Scenes of grief after the killings 3 funeral pyres lit together After post-mortem, the three bodies were brought home under tight security at around 4pm. Their last rites were performed together at around 6pm. According to police, main accused Jeetu fired using Mayank’s pistol. After the crime, the accused fled with the CCTV DVR. Police have registered an FIR against 10 people, including Jeetu and Mayank.

stories.title: Bhaskar Survey tracks 18 high-profile seats in UP:New choices emerge on seats of 4 rebels, 4 strongmen
stories.summary: On completion of four years of the Yogi government, Dainik Bhaskar’s biggest survey has thrown up surprising results. What is the public opinion on the constituencies of 18 prominent MLAs who have remained in the spotlight of Uttar Pradesh politics over the past four years? This includes four rebel SP MLAs as well. On the seats of four strongmen, whom did the public prefer as candidates? A detailed seat-by-seat assessment of MLAs who have, at times, even questioned their own parties is presented below. First, the Assembly Speaker and Leader of Opposition Both unpopular as MLAs Satish Mahana, MLA from Maharajpur in Kanpur, has been elected for the 8th time. During a budget session, he threw away a headset in anger over remarks made by BJP MLA Ketki Singh during a protest. In the Bhaskar survey, people rejected him as a candidate again. However, the BJP remains the first choice as a party in this seat. Mata Prasad, MLA from Itwa in Siddharthnagar, has been elected for the 7th time. He became Leader of Opposition after Akhilesh Yadav resigned. During a by-election in Sisamau, Kanpur, he alleged that the administration was digging roads to stop voters. In the survey, voters rejected him as a candidate, but the Samajwadi Party remains the first choice in this seat. Those who had cornered their own government Nand Kishor Gurjar is a two-time MLA from Ghaziabad’s Loni seat and often remains in the spotlight for his statements. During an Assembly session, when he was not given a chance to speak, he sat on a dharna on the floor of the House in protest. Apart from this, he had termed his own government as the “most corrupt”. He had said that the Chief Secretary had used “tantra-mantra” to control Maharajji’s mind and prevent him from getting a chance to speak during the Assembly session. In the survey, people on the Loni seat expressed their dislike for Nand Kishor Gurjar. From here, BJP district minister Rahul Baisla has emerged as the first choice. Another MLA stopped the convoy of Jal Shakti Minister Swatantra Dev Singh over poor repair of roads dug for the tap-water scheme. In the survey, voters rejected Brijbhushan as a future candidate. The Samajwadi Party is the first choice in this seat. Those who remain in headlines due to controversial statements Pallavi Patel became famous in 2022 after defeating Deputy CM Keshav Prasad Maurya from Sirathu in Kaushambi. She contested with SP support. In 2024, she said PDA stands not for “backward, Dalit and minority” but for “Pallavi, Dimple and Jaya”. The survey shows people do not want her as a candidate again. BJP is the first choice in her constituency. Dinesh Khatik is a minister in the Yogi government. His statement that “Hastinapur seat is cursed” went viral. In his seat, BJP youth leader Amal Khatik is the first choice, while Dinesh Khatik is second.
